# PART II: MENAION (Fixed Feasts of the Lord, Mother of God, and Celebrating Saints)

## ΜΗΝ ΣΕΠΤΕΜΒΡΙΟΣ

**Τῇ Α΄.** Ἀρχὴ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, ἤτοι τοῦ νέου ἔτους καὶ μνήμη τοῦ Ὁσίου Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Συμεὼν τοῦ Στυλίτου, καὶ ἡ Σύναξις τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Θεοτόκου τῶν Μιασηνῶν.

1. Εἰ τύχοι ἡ α΄ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν Α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια τῆς Ἰνδίκτου γ΄, τοῦ Ὁσίου Προσόμοια γ΄ *Ὅσιε Πάτερ*, καὶ ἕτερα Ἰδιόμελα δ΄ *Ἐκ ῥίζης ἀγαθῆς*, *Δόξα* *Θεία χάρις*, *Καὶ νῦν* [*Ὁ*] *Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ*, Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ δ΄ Ἰδιόμελα τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, *Δόξα* *Ὅσιε Πάτερ*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Σὺ Βασιλεῦ*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια τῆς Ἰνδίκτου *Ὁ πάσης δημιουργός*, τοῦ Ὁσίου *Ὑπομονῆς στῦλος*, τῆς Θεοτόκου *Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

## TYPIKON ORDER
### OF THE SERVICE OF VESPERS, MATINS, AND DIVINE LITURGY OF THE MONTHLY FEASTS OF THE LORD, THE THEOTOKOS, AND THE CELEBRATED SAINTS

# MONTH OF SEPTEMBER

**The 1st Day.** Beginning of the Indiction, that is, of the New Ecclesiastical Year; Commemoration of our Venerable Father Simeon the Stylite; and the Synaxis of the Most Holy Theotokos [venerated in her icon] of Miasena.[^139]

1. If the first day of the Indiction occurs on any weekday except Sunday: at Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Kathisma 1: *Blessed is the man*], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 3 Prosomia Stichira of the Indiction, 3 Prosomia Stichira of the Venerable Father: **"Venerable Father"** (*Ὅσιε Πάτερ*), and 4 other Idiomela: **"From a good root"** (*Ἐκ ῥίζης ἀγαθῆς*); **"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit"**: **"Divine grace"** (*Θεία χάρις*); **"Both now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen"**: **"O Holy Spirit"** (*Ὁ Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the 4 Idiomela of the Indiction; **"Glory"**: **"Venerable Father"** (*Ὅσιε Πάτερ*); **"Both now"**: **"Thou, O King"** (*Σὺ Βασιλεῦ*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Indiction: **"O Creator of the universe"** (*Ὁ πάσης δημιουργός*, Tone 2); of the Venerable Father: **"Thou didst become a pillar of endurance"** (*Ὑπομονῆς στῦλος*, Tone 1); of the Theotokos: **"Hail, full of grace, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη*); and Dismissal.

2. Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ Ψαλμὸν τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἰνδίκτου καὶ ὁ ἑξάψαλμος, εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια, ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα καὶ οἱ Κανόνες, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, ἀφ’ ς΄ Τὸ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ τῶν αἰώνων ποιητὴς καὶ δεσπότης*, ὁ Οἶκος *Ἀρρήτῳ, πάντα ὡς Θεῷ ποιήσαντι σοφίᾳ* καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας*, *Τὴν Τιμιωτέραν* καὶ τὰ γ΄ Ἐξαποστειλάρια. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ δ΄ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου Ἰδιόμελα, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ὁσίου *Ἐκ ῥίζης ἀγαθῆς*, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς Ἰνδίκτου *Ὁ ἀρρήτῳ Σοφίᾳ*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἰνδίκτου.

3. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικά, οἱ Μακαρισμοί· Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς Ἰνδίκτου· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, τὸ *Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη*, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ τῶν αἰώνων ποιητὴς καὶ δεσπότης*· Τὸ Τρισάγιον, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Ἰνδίκτου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Εὐλόγησον τὸν στέφανον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

4. Εἰ τύχοι ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ α΄ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῆς Ἰνδίκτου γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου γ΄ τὰ *Ὅσιε πάτερ*· *Δόξα* τῆς Ἰνδίκτου *Ὁ πνεύματι ἁγίῳ*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Ὅσιε Πάτερ*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Σὺ βασιλεῦ*· Ἀπολυτίκια τοῦ Ὁσίου, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, τῆς Θεοτόκου *Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.*

5. Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν* εἶτα, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἰνδίκτου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν καὶ τὸ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου *Ὁ καιροὺς καρποφόρους* δίς, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου χῦμα, καὶ τὸ τελευταῖον Κάθισμα τῆς Ἰνδίκτου *Ὡς δεσπότῃ τοῦ παντὸς* ἅπαξ· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος

2. At Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Indiction, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter, the Kathismata in order, Psalm 50 LXX (recited), and the Canons. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Venerable Father and of the Indiction; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion: **"O Creator and Master of time and seasons"** (*Ὁ τῶν αἰώνων ποιητὴς καὶ δεσπότης*), the Ikos: **"Ineffably, as God Thou didst create all in wisdom"** (*Ἀρρήτῳ, πάντα ὡς Θεῷ ποιήσαντι σοφίᾳ*), and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν Τιμιωτέραν*), and the 3 Exapostilaria. At the Praises: the 4 Idiomela of the Indiction; **"Glory"** of the Venerable Father: **"From a good root"** (*Ἐκ ῥίζης ἀγαθῆς*); **"Both now"** of the Indiction: **"With ineffable wisdom"** (*Ὁ ἀρρήτῳ Σοφίᾳ*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Indiction.[^140]

3. At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, the Beatitudes; Troparia from the Third and Sixth Odes of the Canon of the Indiction. After the Little Entrance: the Dismissal Troparia of the Indiction: **"O Creator of the universe"** (*Ὁ πάσης δημιουργός*), the Theotokion **"Hail, full of grace"** (*Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη*), that of the Venerable Father, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"O Creator and Master of time and seasons"** (*Ὁ τῶν αἰώνων ποιητὴς καὶ δεσπότης*). The Trisagion Hymn, the Epistle [1 Tim. 2:1–7], and the Gospel of the Indiction [Luke 4:16–22]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Bless the crown of the year with Thy goodness, O Lord"** (*Εὐλόγησον τὸν στέφανον τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ τῆς χρηστότητός σου, Κύριε*, Ps. 64:12 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

4. If September 1 occurs on Sunday: on Saturday evening at Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Indiction, and 3 of the Venerable Father: **"Venerable Father"** (*Ὅσιε πάτερ*); **"Glory"** of the Indiction: **"O Holy Spirit"** (*Ὁ πνεύματι ἁγίῳ*); **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: **"Venerable Father"** (*Ὅσιε Πάτερ*); **"Both now"**: **"Thou, O King"** (*Σὺ βασιλεῦ*). Dismissal Troparia: of the Venerable Father, the Resurrection Troparion, that of the Indiction, of the Theotokos: **"Hail, full of grace, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη*), and Dismissal.

5. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Indiction, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and that of the Indiction: **"Thou Who hast appointed fruitful seasons"** (*Ὁ καιροὺς καρποφόρους*) twice; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Indiction with the verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*). After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited), and the final Kathisma of the Indiction: **"As Master of all"** (*Ὡς δεσπότῃ τοῦ παντὸς*) once; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Indiction, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the...

...τὰ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου τὰ τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ *Τῆς αὐτολέκτου καὶ θείας* εἰς δ΄· *Δόξα* *Ὁ ἀρρήτῳ σοφίᾳ*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

6. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς Ἰνδίκτου δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, τὸ *Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη*, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου, καὶ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Ἰνδίκτου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*. Κοινωνικὸν τῆς Ἰνδίκτου, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
    Εἰ τύχοι τῆς Ἰνδίκτου ἐν Σαββάτῳ, τῇ ἐλευσομένῃ Κυριακῇ ἤτοι τῇ ζ΄ [ὀρθότερον τῇ η΄] τοῦ μηνὸς Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον λέγονται τὰ τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως.

---

### Τῇ ς΄. Τὸ ἐν Χώναις θαῦμα τοῦ Ἀρχιστρατήγου Μιχαήλ.

1. Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου δ΄. *Δόξα* *Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου· Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὡς ταξιάρχης καὶ πρόμαχος*, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου, Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

2. Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὴν συνήθη Ἀκολουθίαν, τῆς Κυριακῆς οἱ Κανόνες ἀμφότεροι, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου δ΄, *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. *Σήμερον Σωτηρία* καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

...day [the Synaxarion of the Indiction and the Saints]. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Venerable Father, and that of the Indiction. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Indiction from Vespers: **"The self-proclaimed and divine Wisdom of God"** (*Τῆς αὐτολέκτου καὶ θείας*); **"Glory"**: **"With ineffable wisdom"** (*Ὁ ἀρρήτῳ σοφίᾳ*); **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

§ 6. At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and the Beatitudes of the Tone in 4 and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Indiction. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Indiction, the Theotokion **"Hail, full of grace"** (*Χαῖρε κεχαριτωμένη*), that of the Venerable Father, and that of the Patron Saint of the temple; the Kontakion of the Indiction; the Epistle [1 Tim. 2:1–7] and Gospel [Luke 4:16–22] of the Indiction. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse of the Indiction [Ps. 64:12 LXX], **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^141]

If the Indiction occurs on a Saturday: on the following Sunday—that is, on the 7th [more correctly on the 8th] of the month—the Epistle and Gospel appointed are those of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17].

---

### The 6th Day. The Miracle Performed at Chonae [Colossae] by the Archangel Michael.

1. If this feast [September 6] occurs on a Sunday: on Saturday evening at Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Prosomia Stichira of the Archangel; **"Glory"**: **"Rejoice with us, all ye angelic ranks"** (*Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν*); **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"As supreme commander and champion"** (*Ὡς ταξιάρχης καὶ πρόμαχος*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Troparion, that of the Archangel: **"Supreme commander of the heavenly hosts"** (*Τῶν οὐρανίων στρατιῶν Ἀρχιστράτηγε*, Tone 4), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

2. On Sunday at Matins: after the usual Sunday service, both Sunday Canons, the Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Archangel, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Archangel; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology; **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον Σωτηρία*); and thereafter the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

### Τῇ Ζ΄. Τὰ Προεόρτια τῆς Γεννήσεως τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Θεοτόκου, καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Μάρτυρος Σώζοντος.

1. Ἄν τύχωσι τὰ Προεόρτια ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ Προεόρτια δ΄· *Δόξα* *Τὴν πάνσεπτόν σου Γέννησιν*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Ἡ Παγκόσμιος χαρά*, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Ἐκ τῆς ῥίζης Ἰεσσαί*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
    *(Σημ. Ἡ δὲ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου ψάλλεται ἐν τοῖς Ἀποδείπνοις· εἴ που δὲ ἑορτάζεται ὁ Ἅγιος, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, Προεόρτια γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Καὶ νῦν τὸ Προεόρτιον, λέγεται δὲ καὶ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἀπολυτίκιον).*

2. Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον ἅπαξ, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Τεχθεῖσα παραδόξως*, εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν αὖθις Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Τὰ οὐράνια πάντα*, εἶτα τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ Προεόρτιος, οὗ ὁ στίχος *Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε*, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα *Ἀγαλλιάσθω οὐρανὸς* ἅπαξ· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*· Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Ἀγάλλου κτίσις ἅπασα*. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ Προεόρτια δ΄ *Δεῦτε οἱ ἐξ Ἀδάμ*, *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

3. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον καὶ τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον Προεόρτιον *Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον καὶ θεοτόκος Μαρία* (ζήτει ἀφ’ ς΄ Ὠδῆς). Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως· εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*,

### The 7th Day. The Forefeast of the Nativity of the All-Holy Theotokos, and the Holy Martyr Sozon.[^142]

1. If the Forefeast [September 7] occurs on a Sunday: on Saturday evening at Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast; **"Glory"**: **"Thy most venerable Nativity"** (*Τὴν πάνσεπτόν σου Γέννησιν*); **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"The universal joy"** (*Ἡ Παγκόσμιος χαρά*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Troparion and the Forefeast Troparion: **"From the root of Jesse"** (*Ἐκ τῆς ῥίζης Ἰεσσαί*, Tone 4), and Dismissal.
    *(Note: The service of the Holy Martyr is chanted at Small Compline; if, however, the Saint is celebrated in the temple: at **"Lord, I have cried"** we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Forefeast, and 3 of the Saint. At the Aposticha: **"Glory"** of the Saint; **"Both now"** of the Forefeast; the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint is likewise chanted).*

2. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Troparion twice and that of the Forefeast once; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. Kathismata at the First Stichologia: 2 of the Resurrection, and that of the Forefeast: **"Born miraculously"** (*Τεχθεῖσα παραδόξως*); at the Second Stichologia: again 2 of the Resurrection and that of the Forefeast: **"Let all the heavenly hosts rejoice"** (*Τὰ οὐράνια πάντα*); then the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Forefeast, whose refrain verse is: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"** (*Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε, σῶσον ἡμᾶς*). After the Third Ode: the Forefeast Kathisma: **"Let heaven rejoice"** (*Ἀγαλλιάσθω οὐρανὸς*) once; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Forefeast: **"Rejoice, all creation"** (*Ἀγάλλου κτίσις ἅπασα*). At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast: **"Come, ye that are descended from Adam"** (*Δεῦτε οἱ ἐξ Ἀδάμ*); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology; and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

3. At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Forefeast Canon. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forefeast, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Forefeast Kontakion: **"Today the Virgin and Theotokos Mary"** (*Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον καὶ θεοτόκος Μαρία*, seek it after the Sixth Ode). The Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Communion Verse...

Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ Η΄. Τὸ Γενέσιον τῆς Ὑπεραγίας ἡμῶν Θεοτόκου καὶ ἀειπαρθένου Μαρίας.

4. Ἐν τῷ Μεγάλῳ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν Α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἰδιόμελα *Σήμερον ὁ τοῖς νοεροῖς θρόνοις* εἰς ς΄, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ αὐτό, Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα *Ἡ παγκόσμιος χαρὰ* κτλ. *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Δεῦτε ἅπαντες πιστοί*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἡ γέννησίς σου θεοτόκε* ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

5. Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸ *Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς* τὸ Τρισάγιον καὶ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον αὖθις, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος *Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν ἐκ δευτέρου· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον *Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*, *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον *Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριὰμ*, ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα, *Δόξα* *Ταῖς τῆς θεοτόκου*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Αὕτη ἡμέρα Κυρίου*· οἱ Κανόνες ἀμφότεροι μετὰ στίχου *Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε, σῶσον ἡμᾶς*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ *Πύλην κεκλεισμένην*· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας*, καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδή, ἡ Καταβασία *Μυστικὸς εἶ θεοτόκε*· εἶτα τὰ β΄ Ἐξαποστειλάρια. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια εἰς δ΄, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Αὕτη ἡμέρα Κυρίου*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

...Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

### The 8th Day. The Nativity of our Most Holy Lady Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary.[^143]

4. At Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Kathisma 1: *Blessed is the man*], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Idiomela Stichira: **"Today God Who resteth upon the spiritual thrones"** (*Σήμερον ὁ τοῖς νοεροῖς θρόνοις*); **"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit"**, **"Both now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen"**: the same Idiomelon: **"Today God Who resteth upon the spiritual thrones"**. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Gen. 28:10–17; Ezek. 43:27–44:4; Prov. 9:1–11]. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela Stichira: **"The universal joy"** (*Ἡ παγκόσμιος χαρά*), etc.; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"Come, all ye faithful"** (*Δεῦτε ἅπαντες πιστοί*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Thy Nativity, O Theotokos Virgin"** (*Ἡ γέννησίς σου Θεοτόκε*, Tone 4) thrice, and Dismissal.

5. At Matins: after **"Blessed is our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν*), the Trisagion, and Psalm 50 LXX, the Liti is sung; then the Trisagion again, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion thrice; the Psalter and the Polyeleos: **"My heart overfloweth with a good word"** (*Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου λόγον ἀγαθόν*, Psalm 44 LXX). The Kathismata in order, chanted twice each; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4 [**"From my youth"** (*Ἐκ νεότητός μου*)]; and the Prokeimenon: **"I will commemorate Thy name in every generation and generation"** (*Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*). Then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel: **"Having arisen, Mary went into the hill country"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56); Psalm 50 LXX (recited); **"Glory"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Merciful One, blot out the multitude of our offenses"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου πρεσβείαις*); **"Both now"**: repeat the same hymn. Then the verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"This is the day of the Lord: rejoice, ye peoples!"** (*Αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα Κυρίου*). Both Canons of the Feast are sung with the verse: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"** (*Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε, σῶσον ἡμᾶς*). After the Third Ode: the Hypakoe: **"The closed gate"** (*Πύλην κεκλεισμένην*); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion: **"Joachim and Anna were freed from the reproach of childlessness"** (*Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννα*), the Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross with his rod"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*); and the Ninth Ode is sung with its proper festal refrain and the Katavasia: **"A mystical paradise art Thou, O Theotokos"** (*Μυστικὸς εἶ Θεοτόκε*); then the two Exapostilaria. At the Praises: the Prosomia Stichira in 4; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"This is the day of the Lord"** (*Αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα Κυρίου*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

6. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα.

#### Ἀντίφωνον α΄.
*Μνήσθητι Κύριε τοῦ Δαβὶδ καὶ πάσης τῆς πραότητος αὐτοῦ.*  
*Ἰδοὺ ἠκούσαμεν αὐτὴν ἐν Ἐφραθά, εὕρομεν αὐτὴν ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις τοῦ δρυμοῦ.*  
*Δεδοξασμένα ἐλαλήθη περὶ σοῦ ἡ πόλις τοῦ Θεοῦ.*  
*Ὁ Θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ σαλευθήσεται.*  
*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.*

#### Ἀντίφωνον β΄.
*Ὤμοσε Κύριος τῷ Δαβὶδ ἀλήθειαν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀθετήσει αὐτήν.*  
*Ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς κοιλίας σου, θήσομαι ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου σου.*  
*Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαβίδ, ἡτοίμασα λύχνον τῷ Χριστῷ μου.*  
*Ὅτι ἐξελέξατο Κύριος τὴν Σιών, ᾑρετίσατο αὐτὴν εἰς κατοικίαν ἑαυτῷ.*  
*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστὸς [ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα].*

#### Ἀντίφωνον γ΄.
*Ὧδε κατοικήσω, ὅτι ᾑρετισάμην αὐτήν.*  
*Ἡγίασε τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ ὁ Ὕψιστος.*  
*Ἅγιος ὁ ναός σου, θαυμαστὸς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ.*  
*Ἡ γέννησίς σου Θεοτόκε κτλ.*

Εἰς τὴν Εἴσοδον· *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν ... , ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἡ γέννησίς σου θεοτόκε*, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον *Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννα*· ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως *Ἀλλότριον τῶν Μητέρων ἡ Παρθενία*· Κοινωνικὸν *Ποτήριον σωτηρίου*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

6. At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons.[^144]

#### Antiphon 1 [Psalm 131 LXX]
Verse 1: **"Lord, remember David and all his meekness"** (*Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, τοῦ Δαυῒδ καὶ πάσης τῆς πραΰτητος αὐτοῦ*, Ps. 131:1 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us"** (*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς*).  
Verse 2: **"Lo, we heard of it at Ephrathah: we found it in the plains of the wood"** (*Ἰδοὺ ἠκούσαμεν αὐτὴν ἐν Ἐφραθά, εὕρομεν αὐτὴν ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις τοῦ δρυμοῦ*, Ps. 131:6 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us"** (*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου...*).  
Verse 3: **"Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God"** (*Δεδοξασμένα ἐλαλήθη περὶ σοῦ, ἡ πόλις τοῦ Θεοῦ*, Ps. 86:3 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us"** (*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου...*).  
Verse 4: **"God is in the midst of her, she shall not be shaken: God shall help her early in the morning"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ σαλευθήσεται· βοηθήσει αὐτῇ ὁ Θεὸς τὸ πρὸς πρωΐ*, Ps. 45:6 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us"** (*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου...*).

#### Antiphon 2 [Psalm 131 LXX]
Verse 1: **"The Lord hath sworn the truth unto David, and He will not turn away from it"** (*Ὤμοσε Κύριος τῷ Δαυῒδ ἀλήθειαν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀθετήσει αὐτήν*, Ps. 131:11 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις θαυμαστός, ψάλλοντάς σοι· Ἀλληλούϊα*).  
Verse 2: **"Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne"** (*Ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς κοιλίας σου θήσομαι ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου σου*, Ps. 131:11 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints..."** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ...*).  
Verse 3: **"There will I cause to spring forth a horn for David; I have prepared a lamp for Mine Anointed"** (*Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαυΐδ, ἡτοίμασα λύχνον τῷ Χριστῷ μου*, Ps. 131:17 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints..."** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ...*).  
Verse 4: **"For the Lord hath chosen Sion; He hath desired it for a habitation for Himself"** (*Ὅτι ἐξελέξατο Κύριος τὴν Σιών, ᾑρετίσατο αὐτὴν εἰς κατοικίαν ἑαυτῷ*, Ps. 131:13 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints..."** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ...*).

#### Antiphon 3 [Psalm 131 LXX]
Verse 1: **"This is My resting-place forever and ever; here will I dwell, for I have chosen it"** (*Ὧδε κατοικήσω, ὅτι ᾑρετισάμην αὐτήν*, Ps. 131:14 LXX).  
Refrain: The Dismissal Troparion: **"Thy Nativity, O Theotokos Virgin, hath proclaimed joy to the whole world; for from thee hath shone forth the Sun of Righteousness, Christ our God: and having loosed the curse, He hath given blessing, and having abolished death, He hath granted us life eternal"** (*Ἡ γέννησίς σου Θεοτόκε...*, Tone 4).  
Verse 2: **"The Most High hath sanctified His tabernacle"** (*Ἡγίασε τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ ὁ Ὕψιστος*, Ps. 45:5 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Thy Nativity, O Theotokos Virgin..."** (*Ἡ γέννησίς σου Θεοτόκε...*).  
Verse 3: **"Holy is Thy temple, wonderful in righteousness"** (*Ἅγιος ὁ ναός σου, θαυμαστὸς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ*, Ps. 64:5 LXX).  
Refrain: **"Thy Nativity, O Theotokos Virgin..."** (*Ἡ γέννησίς σου Θεοτόκε...*).

At the Little Entrance: The Entrance Hymn: **"O come, let us worship and bow down before Christ: Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν Χριστῷ· Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις θαυμαστός, ψάλλοντάς σοι· Ἀλληλούϊα*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Thy Nativity, O Theotokos Virgin"** (*Ἡ γέννησίς σου Θεοτόκε*), and the Kontakion: **"Joachim and Anna were freed from the reproach of childlessness"** (*Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννα*). The Epistle [Phil. 2:5–11] and the Gospel [Luke 10:38–42, 11:27–28]. At the Megalynarion [Zadostoinyk]: the Heirmos of the Ninth Ode: **"Virginity is foreign to mothers, and childbearing strange to virgins; yet in thee, O Theotokos, both were accomplished: therefore all we generations of the earth unceasingly magnify thee"** (*Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων ἡ παρθενία*). Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and I will call upon the name of the Lord. Alleluia"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου ἐπικαλέσομαι. Ἀλληλούϊα*, Ps. 115:4 LXX). **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

7. Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς ς΄, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Σήμερον ὁ τοῖς νοεροῖς θρόνοις*· Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Δεῦτε ἅπαντες πιστοί*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

8. Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος *Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*, εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν Καθίσματα Ἀναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἀναβόησον Δαβίδ*, εἰς τὴν β΄ ὡσαύτως Ἀναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἐκ τῆς ῥίζης Ἰεσσαί*, τὸ δὲ γ΄ Κάθισμα ἐκ δευτέρου, καὶ εὐθὺς ἡ Αἴτησις, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ καὶ οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἑορτῆς *Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον *Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, τὸ *Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι* καὶ ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα, *Δόξα* *Ταῖς τῆς θεοτόκου*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ἡ παγκόσμιος χαρά*, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ στίχου *Ὑπεραγία θεοτόκε*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου χῦμα, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἡ Παρθένος Μαριάμ*, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας* καὶ ψάλλονται αἱ δύο τῆς Θ΄ Ὠδαὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τοῦ στίχου *Ὑπεραγία θεοτόκε*· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄, *Δόξα* *Αὕτη ἡμέρα Κυρίου*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

9. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τοῦ *Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον *Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννα*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως· εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως *Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων ἡ παρθενία*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ποτήριον σωτηρίου*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ Θ΄. Τῶν ἁγίων καὶ δικαίων Θεοπατόρων Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννης.

7. If the Feast occurs on Sunday: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 Idiomela Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit"**, **"Both now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen"**: **"Today God Who resteth upon the spiritual thrones"** (*Σήμερον ὁ τοῖς νοεροῖς θρόνοις*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Feast. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"Come, all ye faithful"** (*Δεῦτε ἅπαντες πιστοί*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Troparion and that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.

8. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Feast, and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos: **"My heart overfloweth with a good word"** (*Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*). At the First Stichologia: 2 Resurrection Kathismata and that of the Feast: **"Cry out, O David"** (*Ἀναβόησον Δαβίδ*); at the Second Stichologia: likewise 2 Resurrection Kathismata and that of the Feast: **"From the root of Jesse"** (*Ἐκ τῆς ῥίζης Ἰεσσαί*); the Third Kathisma twice; and immediately the Litany, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon of the Feast: **"I will commemorate Thy name"** (*Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*). Then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Feast: **"Having arisen, Mary went into the hill country"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Μαριάμ*); then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), Psalm 50 LXX (recited); **"Glory"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου πρεσβείαις*); **"Both now"**: repeat the same hymn. Then the verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*), and the Idiomelon: **"The universal joy"** (*Ἡ παγκόσμιος χαρά*). Canons: the Resurrection Canon and both Canons of the Feast with the verse: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"** (*Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε, σῶσον ἡμᾶς*). After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited), then the Kathisma of the Feast: **"The Virgin Mary"** (*Ἡ Παρθένος Μαριάμ*); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and the Synaxarion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*); and both Ninth Odes of the Feast are sung with the verse: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"**; then the Resurrection Exapostilarion and the two Exapostilaria of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory"**: **"This is the day of the Lord"** (*Αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα Κυρίου*); **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

9. At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons of the Feast with the refrain: **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, and the Kontakion: **"Joachim and Anna"** (*Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννα*). The Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]. At the Megalynarion: **"Virginity is foreign to mothers"** (*Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων ἡ παρθενία*). Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^145]

### The 9th Day. The Holy and Righteous Ancestors of God Joachim and Anna.

10. Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἁγίων ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτῶν ψάλλεται ὡς ἐστι διατεταγμένη ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων.
    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων *Δεῦτε νῦν χορεύσωμεν* δ΄, *Δόξα* *Ὦ μακαρία δυάς*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Οἱ ἐξ ἀκάρπων λαγόνων*, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῶν Ἁγίων, *Ἡ γέννησίς σου θεοτόκε* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

11. Τῇ Κυριακῇ μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανὼν καὶ τὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῶν Ἁγίων *Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ ἡ Ἄννα πανηγυρίζουσιν*· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἀδὰμ ἀνακαινίσθητι*. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ *Χάρις τῷ Λυτρωτῇ*, *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

12. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τῶν Ἁγίων, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννα*· Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

13. [Τῇ] Κυριακῇ μετὰ τὴν ἑορτήν· τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ μεθέορτα τῆς σειρᾶς δ΄, *Δόξα* τὸ τῆς Λιτῆς τῆς ἑορτῆς, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* ἐκ τῶν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ...

10. If the commemoration of the Saints occurs on any weekday except Sunday: their service is sung as appointed in the Menaion together with the hymns of the Afterfeast.  
    If the commemoration occurs on Sunday: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saints: **"Come now, let us dance"** (*Δεῦτε νῦν χορεύσωμεν*); **"Glory"**: **"O blessed couple"** (*Ὦ μακαρία δυάς*); **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"They who from barren loins"** (*Οἱ ἐξ ἀκάρπων λαγόνων*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Troparion, that of the Saints, and that of the Feast: **"Thy Nativity, O Theotokos Virgin"** (*Ἡ γέννησίς σου Θεοτόκε*), and Dismissal.

11. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saints, and that of the Feast; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata, and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Saints. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saints: **"Joachim and Anna celebrate"** (*Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ ἡ Ἄννα πανηγυρίζουσιν*); after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Feast: **"Be renewed, O Adam"** (*Ἀδὰμ ἀνακαινίσθητι*). At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Afterfeast: **"Thanksgiving unto the Redeemer"** (*Χάρις τῷ Λυτρωτῇ*); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

12. At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saints. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Saints, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"Joachim and Anna"** (*Ἰωακεὶμ καὶ Ἄννα*). The Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^146]

13. On the Sunday after the Feast: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Afterfeast in order; **"Glory"**: the Doxastikon of the Liti of the Feast; **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: from the Stichira of the Feast. Dismissal Troparia: the...

...Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

14. Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὸ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ· τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος. Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ στιχολογοῦμεν ἀνὰ β΄ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ ἀνὰ α΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. *Σήμερον σωτηρία* καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία μετὰ τῶν Τυπικῶν καὶ Μακαρισμῶν (ἐν οἷς δ΄ ἐκ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς), ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ ΙΒ΄. Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς.

15. Εἰ τύχοι ἡ Ἀπόδοσις ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἡμέρᾳ, ἐξαιρουμένων ἐν μὲν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου καὶ τῶν Ἀναγνωσμάτων, ἐν δὲ τῷ Ὄρθρῳ τῆς Λιτῆς, τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου τοῦ Ὄρθρου καὶ τοῦ Πολυελέου· ἐν τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ, λέγεται Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἡμέρας.

16. Εἰ τύχοι ἡ Ἀπόδοσις ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς ς΄. *Δόξα* τῆς ἑορτῆς, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ τῶν Ἀποστίχων τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δὶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

17. Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ...

...Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, then the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast once, and Dismissal.

14. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion twice, and that of the Feast once; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. Kathismata: at the First and Second Stichologia we sing 2 Resurrection Kathismata each and 1 of the Feast; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Afterfeast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Afterfeast; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy, with the Typika, and the Beatitudes (in which we sing 4 hymns of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Feast); the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

### The 12th Day. The Apodosis of the Feast.[^147]

15. If the Apodosis occurs on any weekday except Sunday: the entire service is sung as on the day of the Feast itself, with the following exceptions: at Vespers: the Psalter and the Old Testament Readings are omitted; at Matins: the Liti, the Matins Gospel, and the Polyeleos are omitted. In the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle and Gospel appointed are those of the weekday.

16. If the Apodosis occurs on a Sunday: then on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory"**: of the Feast; **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: from the Aposticha of the Feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Troparion, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.

17. On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter of the day and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata and those of the...

Ἄμωμος. Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίαν ἀνὰ δύο Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ οἱ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα *Ἡ Παρθένος Μαριὰμ* ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, καὶ μετ’ αὐτὴν ψάλλεται ἡ Θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄, *Δόξα* *Αὕτη ἡμέρα Κυρίου*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, *Σήμερον σωτηρία*, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία μετὰ τῶν Ἀντιφώνων ὡς ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων*· Κοινωνικὸν *Ποτήριον σωτηρίου*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
    Σημειωτέον ὅτι, ὅταν τύχῃ ἡ Ἀπόδοσις ἐν Σαββάτῳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον λέγονται τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως.

### Τῇ ΙΓ΄. Μνήμη τῶν Ἐγκαινίων [τοῦ Ναοῦ τῆς Ἀναστάσεως εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα] καὶ Προεόρτια [τῆς Ὑψώσεως] τοῦ Τιμίου Σταυροῦ, καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Μάρτυρος Κορνηλίου.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἐγκαινίων ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ, πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται μετὰ τῶν Προεορτίων τοῦ Σταυροῦ ὥς ἐστι διατεταγμένη ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ.
2.    Ἄν τύχωσι τὰ Ἐγκαίνια ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων γ΄ καὶ Προεόρτια τοῦ Σταυροῦ γ΄ τὰ ἐν τῷ μικρῷ Ἑσπερινῷ *Ὑψουμένου σου Δέσποτα*· *Δόξα* *Τὴν μνήμην τῶν Ἐγκαινίων*· *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῶν Ἐγκαινίων. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα καὶ νῦν* *Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ*, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων, τὸ Προεόρτιον *Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ὡς τοῦ ἄνω στερεώματος* καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ...Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma: **"The Virgin Mary"** (*Ἡ Παρθένος Μαριάμ*) once; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), and after that the Ninth Ode of the Feast is sung. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Feast; **"Glory"**: **"This is the day of the Lord"** (*Αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα Κυρίου*); **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy, with the Antiphons as on the day of the Feast; the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]. At the Megalynarion [Zadostoinyk]: **"Virginity is foreign to mothers"** (*Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων ἡ παρθενία*). Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

    Note that, when the Apodosis occurs on Saturday, the Epistle and Gospel appointed are those of the Saturday before the Exaltation [1 Cor. 2:6–9; Matt. 10:37–11:1].

### The 13th Day. Commemoration of the Consecration of the Temple of the Holy Resurrection in Jerusalem, and Forefeast of the Universal Exaltation of the Precious Cross, and the Holy Hieromartyr Cornelius the Centurion.[^148]

1.    If the commemoration of the Consecration occurs on any weekday except Sunday: the service is chanted together with the hymns of the Forefeast of the Cross as appointed in the Menaion.
2.    If the Consecration occurs on Sunday: on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Consecration, and 3 Stichira of the Forefeast of the Cross from Small Vespers: **"Lifted high upon the Cross, O Master"** (*Ὑψουμένου σου Δέσποτα*); **"Glory"**: **"The commemoration of the Consecration"** (*Τὴν μνήμην τῶν Ἐγκαινίων*); **"Both now"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Consecration [1 Kings 8:22–30; Prov. 3:19–34; Prov. 9:1–11]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"Thou art my powerful protection"** (*Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ ὑπάρχεις*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Consecration, that of the Forefeast: **"The Life-creating Cross of Thy goodness"** (*Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν*), and Dismissal.
3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic hymn **"It is meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Consecration: **"As Thou hadst shown the beauty of the celestial firmament on high"** (*Ὡς τοῦ ἄνω στερεώματος*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata and...

...ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῶν Ἐγκαινίων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Σταυροῦ καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἐγκαινίων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῶν Ἐγκαινίων *Ἐν πίστει τὰ Ἐγκαίνια* ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων *Μέσον τῆς γῆς ὁ Κύριος* καὶ *Μετ’ εὐφροσύνης κράξωμεν*. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἐγκαινίων δ΄, *Σήμερον ὁ ἔνθεος*, οἱ Στίχοι ὁ α΄ *Κύριε ἠγάπησα εὐπρέπειαν οἴκου σου καὶ τόπον σκηνώματος δόξης σου*· ὁ β΄ *Σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος ὁ Θεὸς ἐν Σιών, καὶ σοὶ ἀποδοθήσεται εὐχὴ ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ*· *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον Σωτηρία*.

4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῶν Ἐγκαινίων, μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον *Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν τῆς σῆς ἀγαθότητος*, τῶν Ἐγκαινίων *Ὡς τοῦ ἄνω στερεώματος*, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον *Οὐρανὸς πολύφωτος ἡ Ἐκκλησία*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
    Ὅταν δὲ συμπέσῃ ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἐγκαινίων ἐν Σαββάτῳ, Ἀπόστολος λέγεται τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῆς Ὑψώσεως, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Ἐγκαινίων, Κοινωνικὸν *Κύριε ἠγάπησα εὐπρέπειαν Οἴκου σου*.

### Τῇ ΙΔ΄. Ἡ παγκόσμιος Ὕψωσις τοῦ τιμίου καὶ ζωοποιοῦ Σταυροῦ.

*(Σημείωσις. Ἰστέον ὅτι, κατὰ τὴν μεγάλην ταύτην ἡμέραν τῆς Ὑψώσεως ἀνεπαύσατο ἐν Κυρίῳ ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἰωάννης ὁ Χρυσόστομος, οὐ ψάλλεται δὲ ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς Ὑψώσεως, μετατεθείσης τῆς μνήμης αὐτοῦ τῇ ιγ τοῦ Νοεμβρίου ἵνα μείνωσι τὰ τῆς Ἀκολουθίας αὐτοῦ ἀνελλιπῆ καὶ ἀμείωτα).*

5.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ Ὕψωσις ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Κυριακῇ, οὐδὲν τῶν Ἀναστασίμων ψάλλομεν, ἀλλ’ ἅπαντα τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς.
    Ἐν τῷ Μ. Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια *Σταυρὸς ἀνυψούμενος*...

...those of the Consecration in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon, that of the Cross, and that of the Consecration. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Consecration: **"In faith the Consecration is celebrated"** (*Ἐν πίστει τὰ Ἐγκαίνια*) once; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints of the day from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and those of the Consecration: **"In the midst of the earth the Lord wrought salvation"** (*Μέσον τῆς γῆς ὁ Κύριος*) and **"With gladness let us cry aloud"** (*Μετ’ εὐφροσύνης κράξωμεν*). At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Consecration: **"Today the God-inspired temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ἔνθεος*), with the following two Verses: Verse 1: **"Lord, I have loved the comeliness of Thy house, and the place of the tabernacle of Thy glory"** (*Κύριε ἠγάπησα εὐπρέπειαν οἴκου σου καὶ τόπον σκηνώματος δόξης σου*, Ps. 25:8 LXX); Verse 2: **"Praise is meet for Thee, O God, in Sion: and unto Thee shall the vow be performed in Jerusalem"** (*Σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος, ὁ Θεός, ἐν Σιών, καὶ σοὶ ἀποδοθήσεται εὐχὴ ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ*, Ps. 64:2 LXX); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

4.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Consecration. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, the Forefeast Troparion: **"The Life-creating Cross of Thy goodness"** (*Τὸν ζωοποιὸν Σταυρὸν τῆς σῆς ἀγαθότητος*), that of the Consecration: **"As Thou hadst shown from on high"** (*Ὡς τοῦ ἄνω στερεώματος*), that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"A fully illumined heaven is the Church"** (*Οὐρανὸς πολύφωτος ἡ Ἐκκλησία*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday before the Exaltation of the Precious Cross [Gal. 6:11–18; John 3:13–17]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.
    When the commemoration of the Consecration occurs on a Saturday: the Epistle appointed is that of the Saturday before the Exaltation [1 Cor. 2:6–9], and the Gospel is that of the Consecration [John 10:22–28]; Communion Verse: **"Lord, I have loved the comeliness of Thy house"** (*Κύριε, ἠγάπησα εὐπρέπειαν οἴκου σου*, Ps. 25:8 LXX).

### The 14th Day. The Universal Exaltation of the Precious and Life-Creating Cross.[^149]

*(Rubrical Note: It must be borne in mind that, on this great day of the Exaltation, our holy Father John Chrysostom reposed in the Lord. His service, however, is not chanted on the day of the Exaltation; rather, his commemoration is transferred to November 13, so that the hymns of his service may remain complete and undiminished.)*

5.    If the Feast of the Exaltation occurs on a Sunday: we sing none of the Resurrection hymns, but exclusively those of the Feast.
    At Great Vespers: after the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter [Kathisma 1: *Blessed is the man*], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 3 Prosomia Stichira: **"The Cross is raised on...**

...εἰς στ΄. *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν*, *Δεῦτε ἅπαντα τὰ ἔθνη*, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Προσόμοια *Χαίροις ὁ ζωηφόρος Σταυρός*· οἱ Στίχοι *Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ·* ἕτερος, *Ὁ δὲ θεὸς βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰώνων εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς*· *Δόξα. Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὅνπερ πάλαι Μωϋσῆς*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου* ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

6.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτή, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν ἐκ δευτέρου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον, *Εἴδοσαν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν*· *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, τὸ *Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ* (ὅπερ λέγεται εἰς οἱανδήποτε ἡμέραν τύχῃ ἡ Ὕψωσις τοῦ Σταυροῦ) καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, *Δόξα*, *Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ ὑπάρχεις*. *Καὶ νῦν*, τὸ αὐτό. Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Σταυρὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ*, ὁ Κανὼν εἰς ἕξ ἄνευ Στίχων, ἐκτὸς τοῦ *Δόξα*. *Καὶ νῦν* ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Κάθισμα ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄, τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Σταυρὸν χαράξας*, εἶτα ψάλλονται τῆς Θ΄ καὶ αἱ δύο Ὠδαί, καὶ αἱ δύο Καταβασίαι *Μυστικὸς εἶ Θεοτόκε*, καὶ *Ὁ διὰ βρώσεως τοῦ ξύλου*, τὸ α΄ Ἐξαποστειλάριον δὶς καὶ τὸ β΄ ἅπαξ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια *Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος* εἰς δ΄ (εἰς τὸ *Αἰνεῖτε* ὁ Πατριάρχης ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς οὐ προσκυνεῖ ὡς συνήθως, διότι μετ’ ὀλίγον μέλλει προσκυνῆσαι τὸν τίμιον Σταυρόν), *Δόξα. Καὶ νῦν* *Σήμερον προέρχεται*, Δοξολογία μεγάλη εἰς ἦχον δ΄ εἰς δὲ τὸ Ἀσματικὸν *Ἅγιος ὁ θεός*, γίνεται ἡ Εἴσοδος τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ κατὰ τὴν ἑξῆς διάταξιν. Ὁ ἱερουργῶν ἱερεὺς στὰς ἐνώπιον τῆς Ἁγίας Τραπέζης καὶ θυμιάσας τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν κείμενον ἐπὶ ταύτης ἐν δίσκῳ μετὰ κλάδων βασιλικοῦ καὶ τριῶν κηρίων, αἴρει τὸν δίσκον καὶ τίθησιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς· στραφεὶς δὲ περὶ τὴν Ἁγίαν Τράπεζαν ἐκ δεξιῶν πρὸς τὰ ἀριστερά, τῶν Ἱεροδιακόνων θυμιώντων καὶ τῶν λαμπάδων, τῶν ἑξαπτερύγων, καὶ τῶν Ψαλτῶν προπορευομένων καὶ μετὰ τούτους τοῦ Πριμικηρίου φέροντος τὸ Διδάμβουλον, τῶν Ψαλτῶν δὲ ψαλλόντων τὸ *Ἅγιος ὁ θεός*, φέρει τὸν Σταυρὸν ἐν τῷ μέσῳ τοῦ Ναοῦ, ἔνθα ἵσταται τὸ Τετραπόδιον ηὐτρεπισμένον καὶ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ περιελθὼν τρὶς ἵσταται, καὶ βλέπων πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, κρατῶν δὲ εἰς χεῖρας τὸν δίσκον ἐκφωνεῖ *Σοφία, ὀρθοί*, καὶ τίθησιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ τετραποδίου· εἶτα θυμιάζων κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ σταυροειδῶς, ...high"** (*Σταυρὸς ἀνυψούμενος*), doubled to 6; **"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit"**, **"Both now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen"**: **"Come, all ye nations"** (*Δεῦτε ἅπαντα τὰ ἔθνη*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Exod. 15:22–16:1; Prov. 3:11–18; Isa. 60:11–16]. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia Stichira: **"Hail, Life-bearing Cross!"** (*Χαίροις ὁ ζωηφόρος Σταυρός*), with the festive Verses: Verse 1: **"Extol ye the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool: for He is holy!"** (*Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἅγιός ἐστιν*, Ps. 98:5 LXX); Verse 2: **"Yet God is our King before the ages: He hath wrought salvation in the midst of the earth"** (*Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰώνων, εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς*, Ps. 73:12 LXX); **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"Whom Moses prefigured of old"** (*Ὅνπερ πάλαι Μωϋσῆς*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance"** (*Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου*, Tone 1) thrice, and Dismissal.

6.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 LXX, the Litē, the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the festal Dismissal Troparion thrice; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Kathismata in order, chanted twice each; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4 [**"From my youth"** (*Ἐκ νεότητός μου*)]; and the Prokeimenon: **"All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God"** (*Εἴδοσαν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν*, Ps. 97:3 LXX). Then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the festal Matins Gospel [John 12:28–36]; then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*, which is chanted on whatever day of the week the Feast of the Exaltation falls), and Psalm 50 LXX (recited). **"Glory"**: **"Thou art my powerful protection"** (*Σύ μου σκέπη κραταιὰ ὑπάρχεις*); **"Both now"**: repeat the same hymn. Then the verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"O Cross of Christ"** (*Σταυρὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ*). The Canon of the Feast is sung in 6 without biblical verses, except for **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma once; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Moses, having etched the cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*); then both Ninth Odes of the Feast are sung, along with the two Katavasiai: **"A mystical paradise art Thou, O Theotokos"** (*Μυστικὸς εἶ Θεοτόκε*) and **"Death, which came upon mankind through the eating of the tree"** (*Ὁ διὰ βρώσεως τοῦ ξύλου*). The First Exapostilarion: **"The Cross is the guardian of the whole world"** (*Σταυρὸς ὁ φύλαξ πάσης τῆς οἰκουμένης*) twice, and the Second Exapostilarion: **"The Cross is exalted today"** (*Σταυρὸς ὑψοῦται σήμερον*) once. At the Praises: the Prosomia Stichira: **"O marvelous wonder!"** (*Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος*) in 4 (at the singing of **"Praise the Lord"** [*Αἰνεῖτε*], the Patriarch or presiding Bishop does not venerate the icons as usual, because shortly he is to venerate the Precious Cross); **"Glory"**, **"Both now"**: **"Today the Cross goes forth"** (*Σήμερον προέρχεται*); the Great Doxology is sung in Tone 4. At the concluding Asmatikon [slow and elaborate chant of the Trisagion]: **"Holy God"** (*Ἅγιος ὁ Θεός*), the solemn Entrance of the Precious Cross takes place in the following order:[^150] The officiating Priest stands before the Holy Table and censes the Precious Cross, which already lies upon it in a tray adorned with sprigs of basil and three lighted candles. The Priest raises the tray and, placing it upon his head, he proceeds around the Holy Table from right to left [counter-clockwise], while the Deacons cense. The processional candles, the Exapteryga [six-winged fans], and the Chanters precede the Cross; following them comes the Primikyrios bearing the Didamvulon [two-wicked candle / double taper]. While the Chanters sing the Asmatikon **"Holy God"**, the Priest brings the Cross to the center of the temple, where the adorned Tetrapod stands. Having circled this Tetrapod three times, the Priest stops and stands before it. Facing East and holding the tray in his hands,...

...ψάλλει τὸ *Σῶσον Κύριε* ἅπαξ, τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ οἱ δύο χοροὶ ἀνὰ μίαν· μετὰ ταῦτα βαλὼν μετανοίας τρεῖς (ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ τύχῃ), καὶ λαβὼν ἀνὰ χεῖρας τὸν Τίμιον Σταυρὸν μετὰ κλάδων βασιλικοῦ καὶ βλέπων πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, ὑψοῖ αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει μεγαλοφώνως. *Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς κατὰ τὸ μέγα ἔλεός σου, δεόμεθά σου ἐπάκουσον καὶ ἐλέησον*, καὶ ἄρχονται οἱ χοροὶ τῆς α΄ ἑκατοντάδος τοῦ *Κύριε ἐλέησον*, τοῦ Ἱερέως σφραγίζοντος ἐν ταῖς ἐνάρξεσι μετὰ τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ τρίς, καὶ κλίνοντος τὴν κεφαλὴν ἠρέμα, ὅσον σπιθαμὴν ἀπέχειν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς· ἀνίσταται δὲ αὖθις κατὰ μικρὸν ἄχρι τῆς συμπληρώσεως τῆς α΄ ἑκατοντάδος· εἶτα στραφεὶς πρὸς τὰ δεξιὰ καὶ βλέπων πρὸς Βορρᾶν λέγει· *Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν εὐσεβῶν καὶ ὀρθοδόξων χριστιανῶν*, καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἄρχονται τῆς β΄ ἑκατοντάδος, ὁ δὲ Ἱερεὺς ποιεῖ τὴν β΄ ὕψωσιν ὡς προδιεγράφη· εἶθ’ οὕτως στραφεὶς πρὸς Δυσμάς, λέγει· *Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἀρχιεπισκόπου ἡμῶν . . .* καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἄρχονται τῆς γ΄ ἑκατοντάδος· πληρουμένης δὲ ταύτης, ὁ Ἱερεὺς στρέφεται πρὸς τὸ Νότιον μέρος καὶ λέγει· *Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπέρ τῶν ἐνδημούντων ἁγίων Ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν ἀποδημούντων ἐν ταῖς ἐπαρχίαις αὐτῶν*, καὶ γίνεται ἡ δ΄ ὕψωσις· καὶ αὖθις ὁ Ἱερεὺς στραφεὶς πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, λέγει· *Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν διακονούντων καὶ διακονησάντων ἐν τῇ ἁγίᾳ ταύτῃ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Μεγάλῃ Ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ὑπὲρ πάσης ψυχῆς χριστιανῶν ὀρθοδόξων, ὑγείας τε καὶ σωτηρίας καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν*, καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἄρχονται τῆς ε΄ ἑκατοντάδος· εἶτα τίθησιν ὁ Ἱερεὺς τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ δίσκου, καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ Πατριάρχης (ἢ ὁ Ἀρχιερεὺς) καὶ λαβὼν αὐτὸν μετὰ κλάδων βασιλικοῦ, βλέπων πρὸς Ἀνατολάς, ὑψοῖ αὐτὸν ψάλλων τὸ· *Ὁ Ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ ἑκουσίως*· θεὶς δὲ τὸν Σταυρὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ δίσκου καὶ προσκυνῶν ψάλλει· *Τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν Δέσποτα*, ἅπαξ τὸ αὐτὸ ψάλλουσι καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ ἀνὰ μίαν· εἶτα ἀσπασάμενος τὸν τίμιον Σταυρὸν εὐλογεῖ τὸν λαὸν καὶ ἀνέρχεται εἰς τὸν θρόνον, τῶν Χορῶν ψαλλόντων τὸ *Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*. Μετὰ τοῦτο προσέρχονται οἱ Ἀρχιερεῖς ἀνὰ δύο κατὰ τάξιν καὶ προσκυνοῦσι τὸν τίμιον Σταυρόν· προσερχόμενοι δὲ λαμβάνουσι παρὰ τοῦ Πατριάρχου τοὺς κλάδους τοῦ βασιλικοῦ ἀσπαζόμενοι τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ· ὡσαύτως καὶ πάντες οἱ Ἐκκλησιαστικοὶ Ὀφφικιάλοι· ἐν τῷ μεταξὺ τούτῳ, ὁ β΄ Χορὸς ψάλλει τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Δεῦτε πιστοί*, καὶ τούτου πληρωθέντος, ψάλλεται τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ἄρχεται ἡ Λειτουργία.

...the Priest exclaims: **"Wisdom! Let us attend!"** (*Σοφία, ὀρθοί*), and places the tray upon the Tetrapod. Then, censing the Cross circularly in the form of a cross [from all four sides of the Tetrapod], he chants the Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου*) once; this hymn is then repeated once by each of the two Choirs. After this, making three prostrations (on whatever day the feast falls), the Priest takes the Precious Cross in his hands with the sprigs of basil and, facing East, raises it aloft and says with a loud voice: **"Have mercy on us, O God, according to Thy great mercy, we pray Thee: hear and have mercy!"** (*Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, ὁ Θεός, κατὰ τὸ μέγα ἔλεός σου, δεόμεθά σου, ἐπάκουσον καὶ ἐλέησον*). The Choirs begin the first hundred chants of **"Lord, have mercy"** (*Κύριε, ἐλέησον*). At the beginning, the Priest signs thrice with the Precious Cross, and then slowly lowers his head until it comes within a span of the ground; he then rises again gradually until the completion of the first hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**. Then, turning to the right and facing North, the Priest says: **"Again we pray for all pious and Orthodox Christians"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν εὐσεβῶν καὶ ὀρθοδόξων χριστιανῶν*). The Choirs begin the second hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**, and the Priest performs the Second Elevation as described above. Then, turning toward the West, the Priest says: **"Again we pray for our Archbishop [Name]"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἀρχιεπισκόπου ἡμῶν...*); the Choirs begin the third hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**, while the Priest performs the Third Elevation. When this is completed, the Priest turns toward the South and says: **"Again we pray for the resident holy Hierarchs and for those absent in their eparchies"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν ἐνδημούντων ἁγίων Ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν ἀποδημούντων ἐν ταῖς ἐπαρχίαις αὐτῶν*), and the Fourth Elevation takes place. Then the Priest, turning toward the East again, says: **"Again we pray for those who serve and have served in this holy Great Church of Christ, and for every soul of Orthodox Christians, for their health, salvation, and the remission of their sins"** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τῶν διακονούντων καὶ διακονησάντων ἐν τῇ ἁγίᾳ ταύτῃ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Μεγάλῃ Ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ὑπὲρ πάσης ψυχῆς χριστιανῶν ὀρθοδόξων, ὑγείας τε καὶ σωτηρίας καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν*). The Choirs begin the fifth and final hundred **"Lord, have mercy"**, and the Fifth Elevation is performed.[^151] Then the Priest places the Precious Cross upon the tray. The Patriarch (or presiding Bishop) comes forward and, taking the Cross with the sprigs of basil, faces East, raises it aloft, and chants: **"Thou Who wast lifted up of Thine own will upon the Cross"** (*Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ ἑκουσίως*). Then, placing the Cross upon the tray and venerating it, he chants: **"We venerate Thy Cross, O Master, and we glorify Thy holy Resurrection"** (*Τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν, Δέσποτα, καὶ τὴν ἁγίαν σου Ἀνάστασιν δοξάζομεν*) once; this is likewise chanted once by each of the two Choirs. Then, kissing the Precious Cross, the Patriarch blesses the people and ascends his throne, while the Choirs chant: **"Many years, O Master"** (*Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*). After this, the Bishops approach two by two in order of seniority and venerate the Precious Cross; as they come forward, they receive basil sprigs from the Patriarch, kissing his right hand; likewise all the Ecclesiastical Officials. In the meantime, the Second Choir chants the Idiomelon: **"Come, ye faithful, let us worship the Life-creating Wood"** (*Δεῦτε πιστοί, τὸ ζωοποιὸν ξύλον προσκυνήσωμεν*). When this is concluded, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** is chanted, and the Divine Liturgy begins.

*(Σημ. Ἰστέον ὅτι ἡ τάξις αὕτη τῆς Ὑψώσεως τοῦ Σταυροῦ γίνεται ἐν τῇ Μ. Ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἔνθα ἄν εὑρίσκηται χοροστατῶν Ἀρχιερεύς· ἀπόντος δὲ τοῦ Πατριάρχου ἢ τοῦ Ἀρχιερέως, μόνος ὁ Ἱερεὺς ποιεῖ τὴν Ὕψωσιν, ὡς καὶ ἐν ταῖς λοιπαῖς Ἱεραῖς Ἐκκλησίαις· ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὴν δ΄ ἑκατοντάδα ὁ Ἱερεὺς λέγει· *Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ ἐλέους, ζωῆς, εἰρήνης, ὑγείας, σωτηρίας, συγχωρήσεως καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν τῶν δούλων τοῦ Θεοῦ, τῶν Ἐπιτρόπων, ἐνοριτῶν καὶ συνδρομητῶν τῆς ἁγίας Ἐκκλησίας ταύτης σὺν γυναιξὶ καὶ τέκνοις αὐτῶν*· κατὰ δὲ τὴν ε΄ ἑκατοντάδα λέγει, *ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ πάσης ψυχῆς Χριστιανῶν Ὀρθοδόξων, ὑγείας τε καὶ σωτηρίας καὶ ἀφέσεως τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν*).*

7.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα.

#### Ἀντίφωνον Α΄ Ἦχος β΄.
*Ὁ θεός, ὁ θεός μου πρόσχες μοι, ἵνα τί ἐγκατέλιπές με;*  
*Μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς σωτηρίας μου οἱ λόγοι τῶν παραπτωμάτων μου.*  
*Ὁ θεός μου κεκράξομαι ἡμέρας καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσῃ·*  
*Σὺ δὲ ἐν Ἁγίῳ κατοικεῖς, ὁ ἔπαινος τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.*  
*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.*

#### Ἀντίφωνον Β΄ Ἦχος β΄.
*Ἵνα τί ὁ θεὸς ἀπώσω εἰς τέλος;*  
*Μνήσθητι τῆς συναγωγῆς σου, ἧς ἐκτήσω ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς.*  
*Ὄρος Σιὼν τοῦτο, ὃ κατεσκήνωσας ἐν αὐτῷ.*  
*Ὁ δὲ θεὸς Βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν, πρὸ αἰώνων εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς.*  
*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα* (οἵα ἄν ἡμέρα τύχῃ).

#### [Ἀντίφωνον Γ΄ Ἦχος α΄.]*
*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, ὀργιζέσθωσαν λαοί.*  
*Κύριος ἐν Σιὼν μέγας καὶ ὑψηλός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς λαούς.*  
*Ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ ὀνόματί σου τῷ μεγάλῳ, ὅτι φοβερὸν καὶ ἅγιόν ἐστιν.*  
*Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου, καὶ εὐλόγησον τὴν κληρονομίαν σου.*

* [Αὕτη ἡ γραμμή, ἡ ὁποία ὑποδεικνύει τοὺς ἀριθμοὺς τοῦ ἀντιφώνου καὶ τοῦ ἤχου, ἔχει παραλειφθεῖ εἰς τὸ Τυπικόν, ἀλλὰ ἔχει ὀρθῶς συμπεριλειφθεῖ εἰς τὸ Μηναῖον εἰς τὴν Θ. Λειτουργίαν τῆς ιδ΄ Σεπτεμβρίου.]

*(Rubrical Note: One must bear in mind that this order of the Elevation of the Cross takes place in the Great Church and wherever a Hierarch presides; but in the absence of the Patriarch or Bishop, the Priest alone performs the Elevation, as is customary in other holy churches. In such cases, at the fourth hundred, the Priest says: **"Again we pray for mercy, life, peace, health, salvation, visitation, pardon, and remission of the sins of the servants of God, the churchwardens, parishioners, and benefactors of this holy church, with their wives and children"**; and at the fifth hundred, he says: **"Again we pray for every soul of Orthodox Christians, for their health, salvation, and the remission of their sins."*)

7.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons.[^152]

#### Antiphon 1 [Tone 2; Psalm 21 LXX]
Verse 1: **"O God, my God, attend unto me: why hast Thou forsaken me?"** (*Ὁ Θεός, ὁ Θεός μου, πρόσχες μοι· ἵνα τί ἐγκατέλιπές με;*, Ps. 21:2 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us"** (*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς*).  
Verse 2: **"Far from my salvation are the words of my transgressions"** (*Μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς σωτηρίας μου οἱ λόγοι τῶν παραπτωμάτων μου*, Ps. 21:2 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us."**  
Verse 3: **"O my God, I will cry by day, and Thou wilt not hear"** (*Ὁ Θεός μου, κεκράξομαι ἡμέρας, καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσῃ*, Ps. 21:3 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us."**  
Verse 4: **"But Thou dwellest in the sanctuary, O Thou Praise of Israel"** (*Σὺ δὲ ἐν Ἁγίῳ κατοικεῖς, ὁ ἔπαινος τοῦ Ἰσραήλ*, Ps. 21:4 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Savior, save us."**

#### Antiphon 2 [Tone 2; Psalm 73 LXX]
Verse 1: **"O God, why hast Thou cast us off unto the end?"** (*Ἵνα τί, ὁ Θεός, ἀπώσω εἰς τέλος;*, Ps. 73:1 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast crucified in the flesh, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι· Ἀλληλούϊα*, on whatever day the feast falls).  
Verse 2: **"Remember Thy congregation which Thou hast purchased from the beginning"** (*Μνήσθητι τῆς συναγωγῆς σου, ἧς ἐκτήσω ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς*, Ps. 73:2 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast crucified in the flesh, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"**  
Verse 3: **"This is Mount Sion, wherein Thou hast dwelt"** (*Ὄρος Σιὼν τοῦτο, ὃ κατεσκήνωσας ἐν αὐτῷ*, Ps. 73:2 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast crucified in the flesh, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"**  
Verse 4: **"Yet God is our King before the ages: He hath wrought salvation in the midst of the earth"** (*Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰώνων, εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς*, Ps. 73:12 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast crucified in the flesh, who sing unto Thee: Alleluia!"**

#### [Antiphon 3: Tone 1; Psalm 98 LXX]*
Verse 1: **"The Lord is king, let the peoples rage"** (*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, ὀργιζέσθωσαν λαοί*, Ps. 98:1 LXX)  
Refrain: The Dismissal Troparion: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance"** (*Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου*).  
Verse 2: **"The Lord is great in Sion, and He is high above all the peoples"** (*Κύριος ἐν Σιὼν μέγας καὶ ὑψηλός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς λαούς*, Ps. 98:2 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance."**  
Verse 3: **"Let them give thanks unto Thy great name, for it is fearful and holy"** (*Ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ ὀνόματί σου τῷ μεγάλῳ, ὅτι φοβερὸν καὶ ἅγιόν ἐστιν*, Ps. 98:3 LXX)  
Refrain: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance."**

* [This line, designating the number of the Antiphon and the Tone, was omitted in the printed Typikon, but is correctly included in the Menaion for the Divine Liturgy of September 14.]

Εἰσοδικὸν *Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι Ἅγιός ἐστι, Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ ὁ σαρκὶ Σταυρωθείς, ψάλλοντάς σοι, Ἀλληλούϊα*· τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Σῶσον Κύριε*, τὸ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ Ὑψωθείς*, ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου *Τὸν Σταυρόν σου προσκυνοῦμεν*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος *Ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ Σταυροῦ*, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον *Συμβούλιον ἐποίησαν οἱ Ἀρχιερεῖς* μέχρι τοῦ *κλίνας τὴν κεφαλὴν παρέδωκε τὸ πνεῦμα*. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Μυστικὸς εἶ θεοτόκε*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Σῶσον Κύριε*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

    Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἐν ᾗ ἄν ἡμέρᾳ τύχῃ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῆς Ὑψώσεως, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς αὐτῆς ἡμέρας, Προκείμενον ψάλλεται τὸ *Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ* μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ. Προσεπισημιωτέον ὅτι ἐν τῇ πανσέπτῳ ταύτῃ ἑορτῇ, φερούσῃ τὰ ἴσα τῆς ἁγίας καὶ Μ. Παρασκευῆς, τελοῦμεν νηστείαν, μόνον δὲ ἂν συμπέσῃ ἐν Σαββάτῳ ἢ Κυριακῇ, γίνεται κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.
8.    Σαββάτῳ μετὰ τὴν Ὕψωσιν. Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ ψάλλεται ἡ ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ ἐνδιάτακτος μεθέορτος τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ Ἀκολουθία, ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ λέγονται οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ τυχόντος Ἁγίου χῦμα, εἰς τὴν η΄ Ὠδὴν ψάλλεται ὁ Εἱρμὸς καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν* μετὰ τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ τυχόντος Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ, ὡς καὶ τὸ *Δόξα Καὶ νῦν*. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, μετὰ δὲ τὴν Εἴσοδον *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν ... ὁ σαρκὶ σταυρωθείς*, Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.
