Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

# ΜΗΝ ΝΟΕΜΒΡΙΟΣ

### Τῇ Α΄. Τῶν ἁγίων Ἀναργύρων Κοσμᾶ καὶ Δαμιανοῦ.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἁγίων ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτῶν ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν.
2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄. *Δόξα* τῶν Ἁγίων, *Καὶ* ...Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon, that of the Earthquake, and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos read plain [*χῦμα*]; then the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the Earthquake: **"From Thy coming unbearable wrath"** (*Τῆς ἐπελθούσης σου ὀργῆς ἀφορήτου*); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint: **"Pierced by spears"** (*Τὸν λόγχαις κληρωσάμενον*);[^167] **"Both now"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); the Great Doxology, and the Sunday Dismissal Troparion: **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

8.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Earthquake, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"O Protection of Christians that cannot be put to shame"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν ἀκαταίσχυντε*). The Epistle of the Saint [2 Tim. 2:1–10] and the Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

# MONTH OF NOVEMBER

### The 1st Day. The Holy Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian.

1.    If the commemoration of the Saints occurs on any day except Sunday: their Service is sung according to the order of the Menaion.

2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saints; **"Glory"**: of the Saints; [**"Both now"**:]...[^168]

νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τῶν Ἁγίων, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ Θεοτοκίον *Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος. Τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄. *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἄλλα δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ κανόνος τῶν Ἁγίων. Ἀπόστολος τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ Η΄. Ἡ Σύναξις τῶν Ἀρχιστρατήγων Μιχαὴλ καὶ Γαβριὴλ καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν Ἀσωμάτων Δυνάμεων.

1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὰ ς΄ κατὰ σειρὰν Προσόμοια, *Δόξα* *Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν ἅπασαι αἱ τῶν Ἀγγέλων ταξιαρχίαι*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν ἅπασαι αἱ τῶν παρθένων χοροστασίαι*. Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια, ὧν οἱ στίχοι *Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα, καὶ τοὺς Λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πυρὸς φλόγα*, καὶ *Εὐλόγει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν Κύριον, Κύριε ὁ θεός μου ἐμεγαλύνθης σφόδρα*. *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὡς Ταξιάρχης καὶ Πρόμαχος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Τῶν Οὐρανίων Στρατιῶν*, Θεοτοκίον *Τὸ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* ...now and ever: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Saints; **"Both now and ever"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saints, the Theotokion: **"Thou who hast mediated for our race"** (*Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν*), and Dismissal.[^169]

3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Hypakoe of the Tone, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Saints. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saints and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints from the Menaion; the Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saints, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saints; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy, in which are sung the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saints. Epistle of the Saints [1 Cor. 12:27–13:8] and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^170]

### The 8th Day. The Synaxis of the Archistrategoi Michael and Gabriel and of the Remaining Bodiless Powers.

1.    At Vespers: after the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 6 Prosomoia in order; **"Glory"**: **"Rejoice with us, all ye ranks of angels"** (*Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν ἅπασαι αἱ τῶν Ἀγγέλων ταξιαρχίαι*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Rejoice with us, all ye choirs of virgins"** (*Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν ἅπασαι αἱ τῶν παρθένων χοροστασίαι*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Joshua 5:13–15; Judges 6:11–24; Isaiah 14:7–20]. At the Aposticha: the 3 Stichira Prosomoia, whose verses are: **"Who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire"** (*Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα, καὶ τοὺς Λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πυρὸς φλόγα*, Ps. 103:4 LXX), and: **"Bless the Lord, O my soul! O Lord my God, Thou art magnified exceedingly"** (*Εὐλόγει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν Κύριον, Κύριε ὁ θεός μου ἐμεγαλύνθης σφόδρα*, Ps. 103:1 LXX). **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"As Leader of the Heavenly Hosts and Champion"** (*Ὡς Ταξιάρχης καὶ Πρόμαχος*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"Of the Heavenly Hosts Archistrategoi"** (*Τῶν Οὐρανίων Στρατιῶν*), the Theotokion: **"The mystery hidden from the ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.
2.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Liti; then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion...

τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον ἅπαξ· τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος. Τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα*, *Πᾶσα πνοή*, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, *Δόξα* *Ταῖς τῶν Ἀσωμάτων, Οἰκτίρμων, προστασίαις*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Τῷ ἀΰλῳ θρόνῳ* (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), ὁ Κανὼν τῆς Θεοτόκου *Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας* καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἀσωμάτων *Τοὺς νοεροὺς τῶν Ἀσωμάτων τάξεων*, οὗ ὁ στίχος *Ἅγιοι τοῦ Θεοῦ*, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*, εἰς τὸ τέλος, *καὶ ᾄσω γηθόμενος ταύτης τὴν Εἴσοδον*. Εἰς τὴν γ΄ Ὠδήν, *Ἐν τῇ σεπτῇ Εἰσόδῳ σου*, εἰς τὴν ε΄, *Ἔνδον εἰσῆλθες ἐν τῷ ναῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ*, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Εἰς τὸ *Ἅπας γηγενὴς* *τὰ ἱερὰ Εἰσόδια τῆς Θεομήτορος*, τὰ Ἐξαποστειλάρια κατὰ σειράν. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια *Τῶν οὐρανίων Ταγμάτων ὡς προεξάρχοντα*, *Δόξα* *Ὅπου ἐπισκιάσῃ ἡ χάρις σου, Ἀρχάγγελε*, *καὶ νῦν* *Μακαρίζομέν σε*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ β΄ Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*· τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον, *Τῶν Οὐρανίων Στρατιῶν*, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος Ναός*. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
4.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν ς΄. *Δόξα* *Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὡς Ταξιάρχης καὶ πρόμαχος* Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, *Τῶν Οὐρανίων Στρατιῶν*, *Τὸ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς ...twice, and the Theotokion once; the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata in order; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire"** (*Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα*, Ps. 103:4 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel [Matthew 13:41–43 or Luke 10:16–21]; then Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Bodiless Powers, O Merciful One"** (*Ταῖς τῶν Ἀσωμάτων, Οἰκτίρμων, προστασίαις*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"**; the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and the Idiomelon: **"To the immaterial throne"** (*Τῷ ἀΰλῳ θρόνῳ*, look in the Liti). The Canon of the Theotokos: **"Having traversed the water"** (*Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*) and that of the Bodiless Powers: **"The intelligent ranks of the Bodiless Powers"** (*Τοὺς νοεροὺς τῶν Ἀσωμάτων τάξεων*), whose refrain is: *Holy Angels of God, intercede for us*; after the Third Ode: the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), singing at the conclusion of the first heirmos: *and I shall sing rejoicing in her Entrance*; in the Third Ode: *In thy solemn Entrance*; in the Fifth Ode: *Thou didst enter into the temple of God*; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). In Ode 9 at **"Let all earth-born"** (*Ἅπας γηγενής*): *the sacred Entrance of the Mother of God*; the Exapostilaria in order. At the Praises: the Prosomoia: **"As chief leader of the heavenly hosts"** (*Τῶν οὐρανίων Ταγμάτων ὡς προεξάρχοντα*); **"Glory"**: **"Wherever thy grace casts its shadow, O Archangel"** (*Ὅπου ἐπισκιάσῃ ἡ χάρις σου, Ἀρχάγγελε*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"We bless thee, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Μακαρίζομέν σε*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.[^171]

3.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes, with Troparia taken from the Third and Sixth Odes of the second Canon. After the Little Entrance: **"O come, let us worship... Who art wonderful in the Saints"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"Of the Heavenly Hosts Archistrategoi"** (*Τῶν Οὐρανίων Στρατιῶν*), that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος Ναός*). At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire"** (*Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους*, Ps. 103:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

4.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 of the Archistrategoi; **"Glory"**: **"Rejoice with us"** (*Συγχάρητε ἡμῖν*); **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"As Leader of the Heavenly Hosts and Champion"** (*Ὡς Ταξιάρχης καὶ πρόμαχος*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, **"Of the Heavenly Hosts Archistrategoi"** (*Τῶν Οὐρανίων Στρατιῶν*), the Theotokion: **"The mystery hidden from the ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

5.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic...

κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν· τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· Τὰ Καθίσματα, ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ ἓν τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ στιχολογίᾳ τὸ τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ β΄ τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος χῦμα, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν δ΄. *Δόξα* *Ὅπου ἐπισκιάσῃ*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

6.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄, καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ β΄ Κανόνος τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*, Ἀπόστολος τῶν Ταξιαρχῶν καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ ΙΑ΄. Τῶν ἁγίων Μαρτύρων Μηνᾶ, Βίκτωρος καὶ Βικεντίου, [καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας Μάρτυρος Στεφανίδος·] καὶ τοῦ ὁσίου Πατρὸς ἡμῶν [καὶ Ὁμολογητοῦ] Θεοδώρου τοῦ Στουδίτου.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἁγίων ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία αὐτῶν μετὰ τῆς τοῦ ὁσίου Θεοδώρου ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν.
2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄. *Δόξα* τῶν Ἁγίων, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* *Τὸν ἀριστέα τοῦ Χριστοῦ*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ἰδοὺ πεπλήρωται*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

...Canon, the Liti of the Archistrategoi, and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata: one Resurrection Kathisma and one of the Archistrategoi with its Theotokion; and in the Third Kathisma reading: that of the Archistrategoi and its Theotokion. The Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and the second Canon of the Archistrategoi. After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited plain), then the Kathisma of the Archistrategoi and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Archistrategoi, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Archistrategoi, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Archistrategoi; **"Glory"**: **"Wherever thy grace casts its shadow"** (*Ὅπου ἐπισκιάσῃ*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

6.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the second Canon of the Archistrategoi. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Archistrategoi, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle of the Archistrategoi [Heb. 2:2–10] and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Who makes His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire"** (*Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς Ἀγγέλους*, Ps. 103:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^172]

### The 11th Day. The Holy Martyrs Menas, Victor, and Vincent [and the Holy Martyr Stephanie]; and our Righteous Father [and Confessor] Theodore the Studite.

1.    If the commemoration of the Saints occurs on any day except Sunday: their Service is sung together with that of the Righteous Theodore according to the order set forth in the Menaion.
2.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saints; **"Glory"**: of the Saints; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: **"The champion of Christ"** (*Τὸν ἀριστέα τοῦ Χριστοῦ*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Behold, the prophecy is fulfilled"** (*Ἰδοὺ πεπλήρωται*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saints, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

Ἡ δὲ τοῦ Ὁσίου Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ἐν τοῖς Ἀποδείπνοις.

3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων· Αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄ (τὰ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ Ἀπόστιχα). *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἄλλα δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ κανόνος τῶν Ἁγίων· Ἀπόστολος τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς· Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ ΙΒ΄. Τοῦ ἁγίου Ἰωάννου τοῦ Ἐλεήμονος καὶ τοῦ ὁσίου Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νείλου.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ἁγίου ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν.
    Εἰ δὲ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, ἡ τοῦ Ὁσίου Νείλου Ἀκολουθία καταλιμπάνεται ψαλλομένη ἐν τοῖς Ἀποδείπνοις καὶ ψάλλεται μόνη ἡ τοῦ Ἐλεήμονος μετὰ τῆς ἀναστασίμου Ἀκολουθίας κατὰ τὴν ἀνωτέρω § 2 καὶ 3 διάταξιν.

### Τῇ ΙΓ΄. Τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἰωάννου Ἀρχιεπισκόπου Κωνσταντινουπόλεως τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου.

1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου Προσόμοια *Τὴν χρυσήλατον Σάλπιγγα* εἰς ς΄. *Δόξα* *Ὅσιε τρισμάκαρ*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε*. Εἴσοδος *Φῶς* The Service of the Righteous Saint is chanted at Compline.

3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Hypakoe, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Saints. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saints and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion of the Saints from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saints, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saints (the Aposticha of Vespers); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then the Divine Liturgy follows, in which are sung the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saints. Epistle of the Saints [2 Cor. 4:6–15] and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^173]

### The 12th Day. Our Father among the Saints John the Merciful [Patriarch of Alexandria], and our Righteous Father Nilus [the Ascetic].

1.    If the commemoration of the Saints occurs on any day except Sunday: the Service is sung according to the order of the Menaion.
    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: the Service of the Righteous Nilus is omitted [from the public office], being sung at Compline, and only that of Saint John the Merciful is chanted together with the Resurrection Service, according to the order of Paragraphs 2 and 3 above.

### The 13th Day. Our Father among the Saints John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople.

1.    At Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Psalms 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 3 Prosomoia of the Saint: **"The gold-wrought trumpet"** (*Τὴν χρυσήλατον Σάλπιγγα*), repeated twice to make 6; **"Glory"**: **"Righteous Father, thrice-blessed"** (*Ὅσιε τρισμάκαρ*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Who will not call thee blessed, O all-holy Virgin?"** (*Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς...*)...

ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια, *Δόξα* *Σάλπιγξ χρυσόφωνος*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἡ τοῦ στόματός σου καθάπερ*, τὸ Θεοτοκίον *Ὁ δι’ ἡμᾶς γεννηθεὶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον ἅπαξ· τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος. Τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Τὸ στόμα μου λαλήσει σοφίαν*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, *Δόξα* *Σήμερον σκιρτῶσιν ἐν πνεύματι*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ἐξεχύθη ἡ χάρις ἐν χείλεσί σου*, Κανόνες ὁ τῆς Θεοτόκου *Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*, καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, εἶτα τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια *Χρυσοῦ τηλαυγέστερον*, *Δόξα* *Χρυσέοις ἔπεσι*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, τὰ Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Ἁγίου· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
4.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου, δ΄, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά. *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ ὁ λυτρωτής μου*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ ...Gladsome Light** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Composite 1: Prov. 10:7, 6, 3:13–16, 8:6 etc.; Composite 2: Prov. 10:31–11:12; Composite 3: Wis. 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomoia; **"Glory"**: **"The golden-voiced trumpet"** (*Σάλπιγξ χρυσόφωνος*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"O Theotokos, thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"The grace of thy mouth shining forth like a torch"** (*Ἡ τοῦ στόματός σου καθάπερ πυρσός*), the Theotokion: **"Thou who for our sake wast born"** (*Ὁ δι’ ἡμᾶς γεννηθείς*), and Dismissal.

2.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Liti of the Saint; then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion twice, and the Theotokion once; the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Kathismata in order; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart understanding"** (*Τὸ στόμα μου λαλήσει σοφίαν*, Ps. 48:4 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel [John 10:9–16]; then Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Today the souls of the righteous leap in spirit"** (*Σήμερον σκιρτῶσιν ἐν πνεύματι*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"**; the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and the Idiomelon: **"Grace was poured out upon thy lips"** (*Ἐξεχύθη ἡ χάρις ἐν χείλεσί σου*, Ps. 44:3 LXX). The Canons: that of the Theotokos: **"Having traversed the water"** (*Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*), and that of the Saint; after the Third Ode: the Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); then the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomoia: **"Shining more brightly than gold"** (*Χρυσοῦ τηλαυγέστερον*); **"Glory"**: **"With golden words"** (*Χρυσέοις ἔπεσι*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"O Lady, accept"** (*Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

3.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes, with Troparia from the Third and Sixth Odes of the Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance: the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*); the Epistle [Heb. 7:26–8:2] and the Gospel [John 10:9–16]. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

4.    If the feast of the Saint occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ ὁ λυτρωτής μου*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

5.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Saint, and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order;...[^174]

Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν, καὶ τὰ τῆς γ΄ στιχολογίας Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὰ ἀναστάσιμα, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος χῦμα, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

6.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Ἁγίου· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου, τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναὸς*, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*. Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ ΙΔ΄. Τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀποστόλου Φιλίππου.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ἀποστόλου ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν.
    Εἰ δὲ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, ὅρα τὴν διάταξιν ἐν τῇ τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀποστόλου Λουκᾶ (Ὀκτωβρίου ιη΄). Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν· Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν ὁ Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον* κτλ.

### Τῇ ΙΣΤ΄. Τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀποστόλου καὶ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ Ματθαίου.

1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ἀποστόλου ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν.
2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸ Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ δ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ, *Δόξα* τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Θεοτοκίον *Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

...and at the third Stichologia the Kathismata of the Saint with their Theotokion; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited plain), then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

6.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle of the Saint [1 Cor. 4:9–16] and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

### The 14th Day. The Holy Apostle Philip.

1.    If the commemoration of the Apostle occurs on any day except Sunday: the Service is sung according to the order of the Menaion.
    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: see the order of the Service of the Holy Apostle Luke (October 18). At the Praises: **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon. At the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle of the Saint [1 Cor. 4:9–16] and Gospel of the Sunday; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), etc.[^175]

### The 16th Day. The Holy Apostle and Evangelist Matthew.

1.    If the commemoration of the Apostle occurs on any day except Sunday: his Service is sung according to the order of the Menaion.
2.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Evangelist; **"Glory"**: of the Evangelist; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Evangelist; **"Both now and ever"**: **"My Maker and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*); the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Evangelist, the Theotokion: **"Thou who hast mediated for our race"** (*Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν*), and Dismissal.

3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*· εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς μετὰ τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ δ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*· καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ Κ΄. Τὰ προεόρτια τῆς ἐν τῷ Ναῷ Εἰσόδου τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Θεοτόκου καὶ τῶν ἁγίων Γρηγορίου τοῦ Δεκαπολίτου καὶ Πατρόκλου Κωνσταντινουπόλεως.

1.    Ἄν τύχωσι τὰ Προεόρτια τῆς Θεοτόκου ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Προεόρτιος Ἀκολουθία μετὰ τῆς τῶν Ἁγίων ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν.
2.    Ἄν δὲ τύχωσιν ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ Προεόρτια δ΄. *Δόξα* *Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Δεῦτε πάντες οἱ πιστοὶ*, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ Προεόρτιον *Χαρὰν προμνηστεύεται* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ

3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostle, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Evangelist. After the Third Ode: after the Kontakion of the Evangelist, his Kathisma and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion; the Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Evangelist, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Evangelist; **"Glory"**: of the Evangelist; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). Then follows the Divine Liturgy, in which are sung the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Evangelist. Epistle [1 Cor. 4:9–16] and Gospel [Matt. 9:9–13] of the Evangelist; Communion Verse: **"Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^176]

### The 20th Day. Forefeast of the Entrance of the Most Holy Theotokos into the Temple, and Saints Gregory the Decapolite and Proclus [Archbishop] of Constantinople.

1.    If the Forefeast of the Theotokos occurs on any day except Sunday: the Service of the Forefeast together with that of the Saints is sung according to the order of the Menaion.
2.    If the Forefeast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast; **"Glory"**: **"Today the temple that is to receive God"** (*Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς*); **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Come, all ye faithful"** (*Δεῦτε πάντες οἱ πιστοί*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forefeast: **"Anna betrotheth unto us joy today"** (*Χαρὰν προμνηστεύεται*), and Dismissal.
3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Forefeast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion twice and that of the Forefeast once; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrec-...

Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων τὰ Προεόρτια, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ Προεόρτιος, ὁ Στίχος *Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τὸ Προεόρτιον *Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον* ἅπαξ· {Αὐτὸ πρέπει νὰ εἶναι λάθος, διότι ὁ ὕμνος *Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον* εἶναι τὸ προεόρτιον Κοντάκιον — ὅρα § 4 κάτωθι — ἐνῷ τὸ Κάθισμα τὸ ὁποῖον συνιστᾷ τὸ Μηναῖον εἶναι τὸ *Ὁ ναὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ*}· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ Προεόρτια (τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῶν Αἴνων) δ΄. *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινὸν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*·

4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Προεορτίου Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ προεόρτιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον *Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ ΚΑ΄. Ἡ ἐν τῷ Ναῷ Εἴσοδος τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Θεοτόκου.

5.    Ἐν τῷ Μ. Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν εἰς ς΄ τὰ Στιχηρὰ (τῆς ἑορτῆς) *Σήμερον πιστοὶ* καὶ τὰ *Τῶν Ἁγίων εἰς Ἅγια*. *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν*, *Μετὰ τὸ τεχθῆναί σε*. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Προσόμοια *Χαίρει ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ*, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Σήμερον τὰ στίφη τῶν πιστῶν*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας* ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
6.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτή· εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος *Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Ἄκουσον, θύγατερ, καὶ ἴδε*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον *Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα. *Δόξα* *Σήμερον...*

...tion Kathismata and, in place of the Theotokia, the Kathismata of the Forefeast. The Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and that of the Forefeast, with the verse: *Most Holy Theotokos, save us*. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Forefeast: **"Filled with joy today"** (*Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον*), once {Note: This must be an error, since the hymn **"Filled with joy today"** is in actuality the Kontakion of the Forefeast — see Paragraph 4 below — whereas the Kathisma appointed in the Menaion is **"The temple of God"** (*Ὁ ναὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ*)}; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the Forefeast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast (the Aposticha of the Praises); **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

4.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Forefeast. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forefeast, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"Filled with joy today"** (*Εὐφροσύνης σήμερον*). Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^177]

### The 21st Day. The Entrance of the Most Holy Theotokos into the Temple.

5.    At Great Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Psalms 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Stichira [of the Feast]: **"Today the faithful"** (*Σήμερον πιστοί*) and **"In the Holy of Holies"** (*Τῶν Ἁγίων εἰς Ἅγια*); **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"After thy birth, O Lady"** (*Μετὰ τὸ τεχθῆναί σε*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [Exodus 40:1–5, 9–10, 16, 34–35; 1 Kings 8:1, 3–7, 9–11; Ezekiel 43:27–44:4]. At the Aposticha: the Prosomoia: **"Heaven and earth rejoice"** (*Χαίρει ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ*); **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Today the choirs of the faithful"** (*Σήμερον τὰ στίφη τῶν πιστῶν*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the prelude of the goodwill of God"** (*Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας θεοῦ τὸ προοίμιον*) thrice, and Dismissal.

6.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Liti; then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion thrice; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos: **"My heart hath poured forth a good word"** (*Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*, Psalm 44 LXX). The Kathismata in order; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear"** (*Ἄκουσον, θύγατερ, καὶ ἴδε*, Ps. 44:11 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56); then Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Today the living temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος*); **"Both now and ever"**: repeat the same hymn;...

ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ αὐτό· *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τῆς Λιτῆς *Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς*, οἱ Κανόνες ἀμφότεροι, ὧν ὁ στίχος *Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὰ δύο Καθίσματα, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*· εἰς τὴν θ΄ ψάλλονται οἱ δύο Κανόνες τῆς θ΄ Ὠδῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων ὡς ἑξῆς·

#### Διὰ τὸν εἰς ἦχον δ΄ πρῶτον Κανόνα.

Ἄγγελοι τὴν Εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου ὁρῶντες
ἐξεπλήττοντο, πῶς μετὰ δόξης εἰσῆλθεν, εἰς τὰ Ἅγια
τῶν Ἁγίων.
Ἄγγελοι τὴν Εἴσοδον τῆς Πανάγνου ὁρῶντες
ἐξεπλήττοντο, πῶς παραδόξως εἰσῆλθεν, εἰς τὰ Ἅγια τῶν
Ἁγίων.
Ἄγγελοι καὶ ἄνθρωποι τῆς Παρθένου τὴν Εἴσοδον
τιμήσωμεν, ὅτι ἐν δόξῃ εἰσῆλθεν, εἰς τὰ Ἅγια τῶν Ἁγίων.
Ἄγγελοι σκιρτήσατε σὺν ἁγίοις Παρθένοι συγχορεύσατε·
ἡ γὰρ θεόπαις εἰσῆλθεν, εἰς τὰ Ἅγια τῶν Ἁγίων.

#### Διὰ τὸν εἰς ἦχον α΄ δεύτερον Κανόνα.

Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου τὴν προσενεχθεῖσαν ἐν τῷ Ναῷ
Κυρίου καὶ εὐλογηθεῖσαν, χερσὶ τῶν Ἱερέων. Δίς.
*Δόξα*, Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου τῆς Τρισυποστάτου . . .
*Καὶ νῦν*, Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου τὴν τιμιωτέραν . . .

Καταβασία *Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου τὴν τιμιωτέραν καὶ ἐνδοξοτέραν τῶν ἄνω στρατευμάτων· Μυστήριον ξένον*, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον *Ἥν πάλαι προκατήγγειλεν* ἐκ τρίτου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια *Λαμπαδηφόροι Παρθένοι* εἰς δ΄. *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* *Σήμερον τῷ ναῷ προσάγεται*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

...then the verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX] and the Idiomelon of the Liti: **"Today the God-containing temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς*). Both Canons, with the verse: *Most Holy Theotokos, save us*. After the Third Ode: the two Kathismata; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*); at the Ninth Ode the two Canons of the Ninth Ode are sung with the Megalynaria as follows:

#### For the First Canon in Tone 4.

The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the Virgin,
were struck with wonder, seeing how she entered with glory into the Holy
of Holies.
The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the All-pure,
were struck with wonder, seeing how she entered marvellously into the Holy
of Holies.
Ye angels and men, let us honor the Entrance of the Virgin,
for in glory she hath entered into the Holy of Holies.
Leap for joy, ye angels, with the saints: dance in chorus, ye virgins:
for the Maiden of God hath entered into the Holy of Holies.

#### For the Second Canon in Tone 1.

Magnify, O my soul, her who was brought into the Temple
of the Lord and blessed by the hands of the priests. (twice)
**"Glory"**: Magnify, O my soul, the dominion of the undivided Godhead
in three Persons.
**"Both now and ever"**: Magnify, O my soul, her who is more honorable
and more glorious than the hosts on high.

Katavasia: **"Magnify, O my soul, her who is more honorable and more glorious than the hosts on high. A strange and wonderful mystery"** (*Μυστήριον ξένον*); the Exapostilarion: **"Whom the multitude of the Prophets foretold"** (*Ἥν πάλαι προκατήγγειλεν*) thrice. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomoia: **"The lamp-bearing virgins"** (*Λαμπαδηφόροι Παρθένοι*); **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Today she is led into the temple"** (*Σήμερον τῷ ναῷ προσάγεται*); the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.[^178]

7.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα·

#### Ἀντίφωνον α΄.

Μέγας Κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα.
Δεδοξασμένα ἐλαλήθη περὶ σοῦ, ἡ πόλις τοῦ Θεοῦ.
Ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ταῖς βάρεσιν αὐτῆς γινώσκεται.
Καθάπερ ἠκούσαμεν οὕτω καὶ εἴδομεν.

#### Ἀντίφωνον β΄.

Ἠγίασε τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ ὁ Ὕψιστος.
Ἁγιωσύνη καὶ μεγαλοπρέπεια ἐν τῷ ἁγιάσματι αὐτοῦ.
Αὕτη ἡ πύλη Κυρίου, δίκαιοι εἰσελεύσονται ἐν αὐτῇ.
Ἅγιος ὁ ναός σου, θαυμαστὸς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ.

#### Ἀντίφωνον γ΄.

Τὸ πρόσωπόν σου λιτανεύσουσιν οἱ πλούσιοι τοῦ λαοῦ.
Πᾶσα ἡ Δόξα τῆς θυγατρὸς τοῦ βασιλέως ἔσωθεν ἐν κροσσωτοῖς χρυσοῖς περιβεβλημένη, πεποικιλμένη.
Ἀπενεχθήσονται τῷ Βασιλεῖ παρθένοι ὀπίσω αὐτῆς.

7.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons:

#### Antiphon 1

Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in His holy mountain. [Ps. 47:2 LXX]
Glorious things have been spoken of thee, O city of God. [Ps. 86:3 LXX]
God is known in her palaces for a refuge. [Ps. 47:4 LXX]
As we have heard, so have we also seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God. [Ps. 47:9 LXX]

{**"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen."** (*Δόξα... Καὶ νῦν...*)}

#### Antiphon 2

The Most High hath sanctified His tabernacle. [Ps. 45:5 LXX]
Holiness and majesty are in His sanctuary. [Ps. 95:6 LXX]
This is the gate of the Lord: the righteous shall enter into it. [Ps. 117:20 LXX]
Holy is Thy temple, wonderful in righteousness. [Ps. 64:5–6 LXX]

{**"Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen."** (*Δόξα... Καὶ νῦν...*)}
{**"O Only-begotten Son and Word of God"** (*Ὁ Μονογενὴς Υἱὸς καὶ Λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ*)}

#### Antiphon 3

The rich among the people shall entreat thy face. [Ps. 44:13 LXX]
All the glory of the King's daughter is from within, robed in golden fringes and embroidered work. [Ps. 44:14 LXX]
Virgins shall be brought unto the King after her: her companions shall be brought unto Thee. [Ps. 44:15 LXX][^179] Εἰς τὴν Εἴσοδον *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας* καὶ Κοντάκιον, *Ὁ καθαρώτατος Ναὸς*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος *Εἶχεν ἡ πρώτη σκηνὴ*, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον *Εἰσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς*. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ποτήριον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

8.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς ς΄, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά. *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δὶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

9.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δὶς, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Δικαίων ὁ καρπός*. Εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Δικαίων ὁ καρπός*. Εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν Ἀναστάσιμα δύο καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Δαβὶδ προοδοποίησον* {Αὐτὸ τὸ Κάθισμα εἶναι ἡ 2α Στάσις ἀμφοτέρων τῆς 20 καὶ 22 Νοεμβρίου.} Εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν, τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἡ Αἴτησις, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἄκουσον θύγατερ καὶ ἴδε*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον *Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, τὸ *Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*, καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, *Δόξα* *Σήμερον ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος* *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ αὐτὸ, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναὸς*. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου χῦμα, εἶτα τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς Καθίσματα {Αὐτὸ εἶναι πιθανὸν λάθος διότι τὸ Μηναῖον ἀναφέρει μόνον ἕν Κάθισμα ψαλλόμενον δίς}, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*, εἶτα ψάλλονται οἱ δύο Κανόνες τῆς Θ΄ Ὠδῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ Καταβασία *Μεγαλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Μυστήριον ξένον*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄, *Δόξα* *Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

At the Little Entrance: **"Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ: save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints..."** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*), the Dismissal Troparion: **"Today is the prelude of the goodwill of God"** (*Σήμερον τῆς εὐδοκίας θεοῦ τὸ προοίμιον*), and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). The Epistle: **"The first tabernacle indeed had regulations"** (*Εἶχεν ἡ πρώτη σκηνή*, Heb. 9:1–7), and the Gospel: **"Jesus entered into a certain village"** (*Εἰσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς*, Luke 10:38–42; 11:27–28). At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the Virgin..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

8.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and 6 of the feast; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings [Ex. 40:1–5, 9–10, 16, 34–35; 1 Kgs. 8:1, 3–7, 9–11; Ezek. 43:27–44:4]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast twice, and Dismissal.

9.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the feast, and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion once and that of the feast twice; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata at the First Stichologia: 2 of the Resurrection and that of the feast: **"The fruit of the righteous"** (*Δικαίων ὁ καρπός*). At the Second Stichologia: 2 of the Resurrection and that of the feast: **"David, prepare the way"** (*Δαβὶδ προοδοποίησον*) {Note: This Kathisma is the second Kathisma appointed on both November 20 and 22}. At the Third Stichologia: the two Kathismata of the feast: **"Before thy conception, O pure Virgin"** (*Πρὸ συλλήψεως ἁγνή*) and **"Let David the psalmist leap for joy"** (*Δαβὶδ ὁ προπάτωρ* / *Σκιρτάτω ὁ Δαβίδ*) {Note: These are the second and third festal Kathismata in the Menaion}, the Litany, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon of the feast: **"Hear, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear"** (*Ἄκουσον, θύγατερ, καὶ ἴδε*, Ps. 44:11 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel: **"Mary arose"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56); **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), and Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Today the living temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἔμψυχος*); **"Both now and ever"**: repeat the same hymn; the verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and the Idiomelon of the Litiya: **"Today the God-containing temple"** (*Σήμερον ὁ θεοχώρητος Ναός*). The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and the two Canons of the feast. After the Third Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (recited plain), then the two Kathismata of the feast {Note: This is likely an editorial error in the printed Greek text, since the Menaion prescribes only one Kathisma sung twice}; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the feast, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*); then the two Canons of the Ninth Ode are sung with their Megalynaria, followed by the Katavasia: **"Magnify, O my soul, her who is more honorable... A strange and wonderful mystery"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Μυστήριον ξένον*); the Resurrection Exapostilarion, and that of the feast twice. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the feast; **"Glory"**: **"Today into the Temple is brought"** (*Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).[^180]

10.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα (ὅρα §7) μετὰ τοῦ *Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος Ναὸς*. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως*, *Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ποτήριον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

11.    Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὴν ἑορτήν, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ μεθέορτα τῆς σειρᾶς δ΄. *Δόξα* τῆς ἑορτῆς *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ, *Δόξα* *Καὶ νῦν* μεθέορτον, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

12.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, {ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς} καὶ τὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν καὶ ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων τὰ μεθέορτα, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ δεύτερος τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινὸν, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

13.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναὸς*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

### Τῇ ΚΕ΄. Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ τῆς ἁγίας Μεγαλομάρτυρος [τοῦ Χριστοῦ] καὶ Πανσόφου Αἰκατερίνης. [καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου Μεγαλομάρτυρος Μερκουρίου.]

10.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons (see Paragraph 7) with the refrain: **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*) at the Second Antiphon; after the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle [Heb. 9:1–7] and Gospel [Luke 10:38–42; 11:27–28] of the feast. At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the Virgin..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

11.    On the Sunday after the feast: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Afterfeast Stichira from the Menaion series; **"Glory"**: of the feast; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**; **"Both now and ever"**: of the Afterfeast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, and Dismissal.

12.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, {the Litiya of the feast}, and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion twice and that of the feast once; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata in order and, in place of the Theotokia, the Kathismata of the Afterfeast. The Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrection Canon and the second Canon of the feast. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel; then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion and that of the feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast; **"Glory"**: the appointed Sunday Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

13.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika, and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone and 4 Troparia from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the feast. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.[^181]

### The 25th Day. The Apodosis of the Feast of the Entrance of the Most Holy Theotokos, and the Holy Great-Martyr [of Christ] and All-Wise Catherine [and the Holy Great-Martyr Mercurius].

14.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ψάλλομεν τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια *Σήμερον πιστοὶ χορεύσωμεν* γ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας γ΄, *Δόξα* τῆς Ἁγίας, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Ἀπόστιχα τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, *Χαίρει ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ*, *Δόξα* τῆς Ἁγίας, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

15.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ Καθίσματα τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χριστὸς γεννᾶται* καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας γ΄, *Δόξα* τῆς Ἁγίας, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

16.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναὸς*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Ἁγίας. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον ... Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ Θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ποτήριον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

17.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ Ἀπόδοσις ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας γ΄. *Δόξα* τῆς ἑορτῆς, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ, *Δόξα* τῆς Ἁγίας, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῆς Ἁγίας, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

18.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἕν τῆς ἑορτῆς. {Ἐννοεῖται ὅτι τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντικαθιστᾷ τὸ Θεοτοκίον τῶν ἀναστασίμων Καθισμάτων}· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου

14.    At Great Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 3 Prosomoia Stichira of the feast: **"Today, ye faithful, let us dance with joy"** (*Σήμερον πιστοὶ χορεύσωμεν*) and 3 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Stichira of the feast: **"Heaven and earth rejoice today"** (*Χαίρει ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ*); **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, that of the Saint, and again that of the feast, and Dismissal.

15.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter, the Kathismata of the Saint and of the feast, Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain), and both Canons of the feast and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the feast; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the Ninth Ode of the feast is sung with the Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: that of the Saint and that of the feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomoia of the feast and 3 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; the Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the feast.

16.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons of the feast. After the Little Entrance: the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle [Gal. 3:23–4:5] and Gospel [Mark 5:24–34] of the Saint. At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the Virgin..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς Παρθένου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

17.    If the Apodosis occurs on a Sunday: at Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Kathisma of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the feast, and 3 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: of the feast; **"Both now and ever"**: the First Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*) and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the feast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, and that of the feast, and Dismissal.

18.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymn: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion of the feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Kathismata and one of the feast {Note: It should be understood that the Kathisma of the feast replaces the Theotokion of the Resurrection Kathismata}. The Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons...

καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, καὶ ψάλλεται καὶ ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄. *Δόξα* *Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ὑπερευλογημένη*. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

19.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἰς τὸ β΄ Ἀντίφωνον, *Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τῆς Ἁγίας, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ὁ καθαρώτατος Ναὸς*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς πανάγνου . . . Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*, Κοινωνικὸν *Ποτήριον*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

    Σημειωτέον ὅτι, μετὰ τὴν Ἀπόδοσιν τῆς ἑορτῆς τῇ πρώτῃ Κυριακῇ ἢ ἑορτῇ, ψάλλεται τὸ Προεόρτιον Κοντάκιον τῶν Χριστουγέννων *Ἡ παρθένος σήμερον τὸν προαιώνιον Λόγον*.

### Τῇ Λ΄. Τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀποστόλου Ἀνδρέου τοῦ Πρωτοκλήτου.

1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ ἑσπέρια Προσόμοια *Ὁ τῷ Προδρόμου φωτὶ μεμορφωμένος* εἰς ς΄. *Δόξα* *Τὴν τῶν ἰχθύων ἄγραν*, *Καὶ νῦν* Προεόρτιον *Ἡσαΐα χόρευε*. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα· εἶτα τὰ Ἀπόστιχα· *Δόξα* *Τὸν συναίμονα Πέτρου*, *Καὶ νῦν* Προεόρτιον *Ἰωσὴφ εἰπὲ ἡμῖν*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ὡς τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόκλητος*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Τὸ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτὴ, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον ἅπαξ, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα. *Δόξα* *Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀποστόλου*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ταῖς τῆς θεοτόκου*, Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν* ...the Resurrection Canon, that of the feast, and that of the Saint. After the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the feast; after the Sixth Ode: the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Synaxarion from the Menaion. The Katavasiai: **"Christ is born, give ye glory"** (*Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*), and the entire order of the Sunday Morning Gospel. Then we sing the biblical canticle with **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), and the Ninth Ode of the feast is sung with its Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: the Resurrection Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and that of the feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory"**: **"Today into the Temple is brought"** (*Σήμερον τῷ Ναῷ προσάγεται*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art Thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); the Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation has come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

19.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Festal Antiphons of the feast, with the refrain: **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*) at the Second Antiphon. After the Little Entrance: the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the feast, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the temple, and the Kontakion: **"The most pure Temple of the Saviour"** (*Ὁ καθαρώτατος ναός*). Epistle of the Saint [Gal. 3:23–4:5] and Gospel of the Sunday. At the Megalynarion: **"The Angels, beholding the Entrance of the All-pure..."** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν εἴσοδον τῆς πανάγνου*) with **"As the living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos"** (*Ὡς ἐμψύχῳ θεοῦ Κιβωτῷ*); Communion Verse: **"I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX), **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

    It should be noted that, following the Apodosis of the feast, on the first Sunday or feast that follows, we chant the Forefeast Kontakion of the Nativity of Christ: **"Today the Virgin cometh to the cave"** (*Ἡ παρθένος σήμερον τὸν προαιώνιον Λόγον*).[^182]

### The 30th Day. The Holy Apostle Andrew the First-Called.

1.    At Vespers: following the Introductory Psalm [Psalm 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Psalms 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we sing the 3 Prosomoia Stichira: **"Illumined with the light of the Forerunner"** (*Ὁ τῷ Προδρόμου φωτὶ μεμορφωμένος*) doubled to 6; **"Glory"**: **"Leaving the catching of fish"** (*Τὴν τῶν ἰχθύων ἄγραν*); **"Both now and ever"**: the Forefeast Theotokion: **"Rejoice, O Isaiah"** (*Ἡσαΐα χόρευε*). Entrance with the censer: **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings [1 Pet. 1:1–2:6 composite; 1 Pet. 2:11–24 composite; 1 Pet. 3:8–4:11 composite]. Then the Aposticha; **"Glory"**: **"The kinsman of Peter"** (*Τὸν συναίμονα Πέτρου*); **"Both now and ever"**: the Forefeast Theotokion: **"Joseph, tell us"** (*Ἰωσὴφ εἰπὲ ἡμῖν*); the Dismissal Troparion: **"As the first-called of the Apostles"** (*Ὡς τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόκλητος*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"The mystery hidden from the ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ’ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

2.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya; then the Trisagion, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion twice and the Theotokion once; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata in order; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel [Matt. 4:18–23]; Psalm 50 [LXX] (recited plain); **"Glory"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Apostle"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀποστόλου*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** [Ps. 50:3 LXX], and...

*με ὁ θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ὁ πρωτόκλητος μαθητής* (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), ὁ Κανὼν τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ τοῦ Μηναίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου *Τὴν τεθολωμένην μου ψυχήν*, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χριστὸς γεννᾶται*· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, τὰ δύο Ἐξαποστειλάρια καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ Προσόμοια *Βηθσαϊδὰ νῦν ἀγάλλου* εἰς δ΄. *Δόξα* *Τὸν κήρυκα τῆς πίστεως*, *Καὶ νυν* Προεόρτιον *Ὑπόδεξαι Βηθλεὲμ*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί. Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ α΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ τοῦ β΄ Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου. Εἰς τὸ *Ἐξαιρέτως* *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

4.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου δ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ, *Δόξα* *Τὸν συναίμονα Πέτρου*, *Καὶ νῦν* *Ἰωσὴφ εἰπὲ ἡμῖν*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

5.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα ἀνὰ ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ ἓν τοῦ Ἀποστόλου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου. Ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ Στιχολογίᾳ , τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ α΄ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου *Τὴν τεθολωμένην μου ψυχήν*, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου χῦμα καὶ τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χριστὸς γεννᾶται* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον.
